title.rendered: Best MacBook cooling pads in 2026

content.rendered:
Whether you are a travel writer or a tech blogger, you need to carry your laptops wherever you go. Different geographies affect the performance of your MacBook, and sometimes, the device gets hotter. To avoid this situation, a cooling pad is one of the must-have MacBook accessories. Here we have listed some of the best cooling pads for your MacBook.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Targus
  • 2. Tree New Bee
  • 3. Havit
  • 4. Kootek
  • 5. Cooler Master
  • 6. TopMate
  • 7. AICHESON
  • 8. TECKNET
  • 9. KLIM Wind

1. Targus

Whether you are airborne or sitting on a couch at home, the Targus cooling pad continues to cool your MacBook. A mini-USB cable allows you to connect your laptop or computer to the pad. To deliver the best performance, Targus has installed two fans, which keep your laptop cool.

Four levels of adjustment let you use this pad as a laptop stand if you own an external keyboard. Check that Velcro strap, which keeps your peripheral cables organized. Robust construction can endure long-distance travel.

Pros

  • Four-level adjustments
  • Dual fans
  • Velcro straps for peripherals

Cons

  • Make some noise

Check out on Amazon

2. Tree New Bee

One size fits all! Tree New Bee has crafted a unique cooling pad for all your Apple laptops. Install your MacBooks and enjoy the best screen height to your eye level. An ergonomic design helps you raise the laptop and keeps the desk clutter-free.

An anti-skid silicone pad makes a lot of difference as it offers the stability of the bracket. Moreover, the same pad ensures full protection of your MacBook against scratches. One of the striking features is an integrated stand for your iPhone and iPad.

Pros

  • Integrated stand for iPhone and iPad
  • Ergonomic design
  • Keeps your desk organized

Cons

  • Not portable

Check out on Amazon

3. Havit

Here is a slim, portable, and lightweight cooling pad for MacBook. Now you can roam around the world with this ultra-portable device to get more out of your laptop. Unlike Targus’s, this one has only two adjustable height levels; however, this product doubles as an ergonomic stand.

This pad is made of metal mesh to provide a stable surface and protect your laptop against daily wear and tear. Don’t miss that extra USB port, which lets you connect more USB devices.

Pros

  • Metal mesh
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Three fans

Cons

  • Need Type C to USB connector for USB-C devices

Check out on Amazon

4. Kootek

Want to keep your cabin quiet? Check this Kootek MacBook cooling pad, which boasts super quiet fans that create a noise-free environment for you at the office and home. Unlike other cooling pads, this one has five built-in fans with Blue LEDs. You can control the fans by two switches to turn them on and off. The best thing about this pad is you can press the switch to select one fan, four fans, or all five fans working together.

A glaring feature is six adjustable height settings; using different levels, you can use your laptop to play games, watch movies, or read eBooks. Use this pad for your 12 to 17-inch laptops.

Pros

  • Super quiet fans
  • Three working modes
  • Controllable LEDs

Cons

  • Plastic material may wear after some time

Check out on Amazon

5. Cooler Master

Cooler Master packs a high-performance 160mm fan, which spins at approximately 1500 RPM. A heavy-duty and yet slim, this MacBook cooling pad is a perfect partner for gamers. You can play your favorite games for hours together.

For cable management, Cooler Master provides cable grooves, which keep your desktop neat and clean. A notable feature of this product is moveable cooling fans; these are patented quick-release fans, which can be adjusted to your laptop’s specific layouts.

Pros

  • Patented quick-release fans
  • Cable grooves
  • High-performance 160mm fan

Cons

  • Only two height adjusting levels

Check out on Amazon

6. TopMate

If you are looking for a budget cooling pad, TopMate (apart from Tree New Bee) is the best choice. An affordable pad that has some impressive features like two 4.92-inch quiet fans, lightweight (1.1lb), comfortable typing & viewing experience. Excellent for playing games on your MacBooks.

Two non-slip baffles stop the laptop from falling down; you can adjust your laptop at the right angle by using two adjustable height settings. Two USB ports – one is to power the laptop and another is used for other devices.

Pros

  • Affordable cooling pad
  • Lightweight (1.1lb)
  • Compact (fits into your backpack or briefcase)

Cons

  • Moves air slowly

Check out on Amazon

7. AICHESON

AICHESON has the capacity to cool down a laptop of up to 17.3-inch. You can rely on this cooling pad for all your MacBooks from 12 to 16 inches. Some of the extraordinary features include wave metal mesh, four small fans, one big fan (1000-1500RPM), a flip-up silicone holder, four height adjustments, two USB ports, and a foam pad.

With so many features, this pad justifies its reasonable price tag. For the elevation mechanism, AICHESON provides a metal bar at the bottom; this bar also ensures an ergonomic design.

Pros

  • Foam pad
  • Five fans
  • Flip-up silicone holder

Cons

  • May not use in your lap

Check out on Amazon

8. TECKNET

The metal net design of the TeckNet cooling pad gives amazing airflow to help keep your MacBook cool. Moreover, the pad avoids overheating during your long gameplays or online browsing. To make it simple in use, TechNet provides 110mm fans with a power switch design and two USB ports.

A slim and portable cooling pad is easy to carry, thanks to its lightweight profile. You can easily carry around the product at airports, railway terminals, and other public places. You can adjust your laptop at the right angle and achieve the best position to type long documents and emails.

Pros

  • Slim and portable design
  • Avoids overheating
  • Metal net in the large area

Cons

  • Not quiet enough

Check out on Amazon

9. KLIM Wind

Butterfly design of this cooling pad will quickly grab your attention. But there is more to this product than just aesthetics. A closure look reveals that the laptop cooler is compatible with nearly all devices. And this wide compatibility includes all Apple laptops from 11 to 16 inches.

In addition to its compatibility, this KLIM cooler has two rear legs for an excellent inclination and its frontal pegs keep your laptop in place. Your MacBook will feel amazing refrigeration with four powerful fans that spin up to 1200 rotations per minute.

Pros

  • 1200 rotations per minute
  • Butterfly design
  • Multifunctional (works with gaming laptops, Play Station 4, Xbox One, etc.)

Cons

  • Need to improve durability

Check out on Amazon

That’s all friends!

Which is the best cooling pad for your MacBook? Let me help you. Choose the one with strong material, perfect design, collapsible, and portable functionality. Make sure the cooling pad should not occupy much space in your travel bag.

What is your favorite cooling pad for your MacBook? Share your thoughts in the comment below.

title.rendered: Best bags for MacBook Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
When you buy a MacBook Pro, you have to treat it as an investment. Just like any other investment, you have to ensure that your MacBook is protected. In this case, you can use laptop sleeves or screen protectors to give it a certain amount of protection. However, I’ve found that bags and backpacks are the best way to protect your MacBook Pro from scratches and spills. This is why I’ve curated a list of the best bags for MacBook Pro.

Table of Contents
  • 8 Best backpacks for MacBook Pro
    • 1. Matein travel MacBook Pro backpack
    • 2. SANDMARC Travel Backpack
    • 3. MANCIO business bag
    • 4. Smatree backpack for MacBook
    • 5. NIDOO shoulder bag
    • 6. BOPAI anti-theft Mac backpack
    • 7. MAXTOP storage laptop backpack
    • 8. Muzee waterproof bag

8 Best backpacks for MacBook Pro

Whether you are a student, professional, or creator, this list of MacBook Pro backpacks has products hand-picked to serve various purposes. Let’s have a look at these bags now, shall we?

1. Matein travel MacBook Pro backpack

Whether you’re a college student or a businessperson, the things you look for in a backpack for MacBook Air are simple. You look for durability, timeless design, anti-theft features, water resistance, and USB charging cables.

Thankfully, you get all of these in Matein’s bag for MacBook Pro. It can hold laptops of up to 15.6-inch screen sizes. Moreover, there are charging cables inside the bag and a charger built outside of it to ensure that you never run out of power. If you’ve got valuables to store, you can store them in the anti-theft pocket to keep them out of reach.

It’s got a timeless design and can fit anywhere, whether college, casual, or business casual. If you’re into traveling often, you can take this bag for MacBook Pro as it has multiple compartments and large storage spaces. Overall, it provides everything you’d want in a backpack for MacBook.

The only issue that I have with this bag for MacBook Pro is that it doesn’t have protective padding at the bottom for your laptop.

Pros

  • Large carrying capacity
  • Built-in USB port for charging
  • Anti-theft pocket
  • Perfect for most scenarios

Cons

  • No protective padding at the bottom

Check out on Amazon

2. SANDMARC Travel Backpack

SANDMARC brands this as the ultimate travel backpack for creators on the move, and when I tell you about its features, you’ll know why they are right.

This backpack comes with purposeful compartments for creators who use their iPhones and Macs to shoot/edit content on the go. It can safely house all your accessories, such as gimbals, hard disks, lenses, and more. The large compartment at the back can easily carry a 16-inch MacBook Pro, an iPad, chargers, external lights, and filters.

Now, you might think that this could bulk up the backpack and eat up all the space. No! With all this gear inside, you’ll still have space to store your clothes and toiletries for a good couple of days. If it gets heavy to carry on the shoulders, you can tilt the bag and use the cushioned holders to carry it as a duffle.

The standout feature for me is the discreet iPhone holder on the shoulder strap. Trust me; you can insert an iPhone 15 Pro Max into the strap and shoot videos while walking! I can keep talking about the stuff this bag can hold, but this space wouldn’t be enough, so I’d highly recommend checking out their website using the link below.

To sum up, if you are someone who travels often with all your photography gear, iPhone, iPad, and Mac, you should definitely get this backpack.

Pros

  • Practical and sleek design
  • Dedicated pockets for all accessories
  • Bag material can sustain rugged use

Cons

  • Some might find it slightly overpriced

Check out on SANDMARC

3. MANCIO business bag

This bag for MacBook Pro from MANCIO is a trendy bag with a slim and lightweight factor. This bag is a perfect fit for those who don’t like to carry anything bulky. The bag has a trendy design with multiple pockets and padded shoulder straps to alleviate the pressure on your shoulders. Moreover, there are five compartments to store your laptop and varied accessories.

Finally, there’s a USB port design available for charging your phone on the go. Say goodbye to low battery days! Unfortunately, the side compartments are too small and tight to fit larger water bottles.

Pros

  • Slim form factor
  • Decent design
  • Padded shoulder straps and multiple pockets
  • USB port design

Cons

  • Side compartments are far too small

Check out on Amazon

4. Smatree backpack for MacBook

You look at some backpacks and think they are strictly meant for business and formal occasions. The Smatree bag for MacBook Pro will evoke the same feelings when you look at it for the first time.

The bag has a unique design whose patent is pending. The inner compartment can hold laptops of all sizes, while the outer compartment is perfect for bundling in your accessories. This uses the available space optimally for the best weight distribution.

Moreover, there’s a hard case on the bag’s outer layer to protect your valuables from drops and scratches. In addition, the zips are from the reputed YKK brand, ensuring durability for years to come.

However, one issue with the bag is that the shoulder straps haven’t been padded properly. If you carry too many things or carry the backpack for too long, you may face shoulder pains.

Pros

  • Unique design
  • Business-specific design
  • Good weight distribution
  • Hard outer case to protect laptops

Cons

  • Shoulder straps aren’t padded properly

Check out on Amazon

5. NIDOO shoulder bag

Sometimes, certain products come along that perform so many functions that you’re not sure what niche they’d belong to. This bag for MacBook Pro is one of those products.

Apart from the slim form factor and efficient looks, parts of the bag can be advjusted to your liking. If you want a messenger shoulder bag, you’ve got it. Want a crossbody or briefcase bag? This bag can be adjusted for those scenarios as well. There’s almost no limit to what you can do with this bag.

In addition, the bag is splashproof and has multiple large compartments. You don’t have to worry about the inner compartments, as they’re lined with fluff and foam padding to protect your gadgets from drops and shocks.

However, I’d recommend you not use the bag for too many gadgets or accessories as it can get quite uncomfortable to carry with the extra weight.

Pros

  • Slim form factor
  • It can be adjusted in multiple ways
  • Large compartments which offer protection
  • Splashproof

Cons

  • Can’t handle too much weight

Check out on Amazon

6. BOPAI anti-theft Mac backpack

This backpack for MacBook Air has plenty of features to make your commute easier. Moreover, it looks great too. Essentially, the bag is made of microfiber leather and ballistic nylon material, making the bag water-resistant and splashproof. Who wouldn’t like the sleek, black faux leather finish?

Coming to the features, there’s an invisible anti-theft design on the bag. It consists of a concealed double zipper design that even you might miss if you’re not watching closely!

The only issue with this bag is that it’s quite expensive. In addition, the USB charging port design makes it convenient when your phone needs power, and power source access isn’t an option. It also has an invisible card holding pocket on the shoulder straps for easy access.

Pros

  • Plenty of nifty features
  • Decent build quality
  • Anti-theft design
  • USB charging port added

Cons

  • Expensive price tag

Check out on Amazon

7. MAXTOP storage laptop backpack

With college students, the essentials tend to be the same. You need a bag for MacBook Pro that can hold all your gadgets, provide enough space for accessories, looks cool, and can charge your phone.

With this bag from MAXTOP, you get each of these features. There’s the main, roomy compartment for holding your laptop and all the accessories. On the side, you get two other compartments for your water bottles and pencil cases.

The USB port and cable provided do a good job of charging the phone. The port placement makes it easier for students to access their phones.

I’d recommend that prospective buyers limit the amount of luggage they carry inside the bag. Its weight distribution isn’t perfect, especially when there’s more to carry.

Pros

  • Perfect for college students
  • Provides all the essentials

Cons

  • Not designed to carry too much weight

Check out on Amazon

8. Muzee waterproof bag

For businesspersons and minimalists, this bag for MacBook Pro is an excellent choice. It offers a minimalistic yet elegant design that many will love instantly. The bag isn’t just about looks either. From USB charging ports to highly durable zippers to emergency whistles, there are a lot of features about this bag that you shouldn’t overlook.

It’s also got padded air cushions at the back to make it a more comfortable carry. Ultimately, the bag looks great and has a handful of nifty features that can be utilized well.

I’m not a big fan of the price, though. This bag is quite expensive for the features that it brings.

Pros

  • Minimalist design aesthetics
  • Emergency whistle
  • Durable zippers
  • Padded air cushions

Cons

  • Lofty price tag

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up

These are our top picks for the best bags for MacBook Pro. What kind of bags do you prefer to use? Have you used any of the products mentioned here? If yes, how was your personal experience? Post all your thoughts and opinions in the comment section!

  • Best USB-C Power Banks for MacBook Pro
  • Top iPhone docking stations for everyday usage

title.rendered: Best Mac keyboards for programming and editing in 2026

content.rendered:
While the keyboards provided with MacBooks are quite ergonomic and benefit various work styles, constantly working on them can be tedious on the laptop itself. If you work for hours each day, it can cause issues with the keyboard relatively early. The best keyboards for Mac are your solution to this issue!

This list provides the best Mac keyboards that you can use for programming, editing, and beyond. Let’s dive into the list and find the right keyboard for you!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple Magic Keyboard – Editor's choice
  • 2. Logitech MX Keys advanced keyboard – Best low-profile keyboard
  • 3. Logitech ERGO K860 – Excellent ergonomics
  • 4. iClever BK10 – Pairs with 3 devices simultaneously
  • 5. KLIM Chroma – Comes with a 5-year warranty
  • 6. Keychron K2 – Best mechanical keyboard
  • 7. Macally – Magic Keyboard-like design
  • 8. OMOTON – Value for money
  • 9. Das Keyboard 4 – Durability champion

1. Apple Magic Keyboard – Editor’s choice

  • Connectivity – Wireless, Bluetooth, Lightning to USB
  • Weight – 0.86lbs

If we’re talking about MacBooks, we must talk about the Apple Magic Keyboard. It’s simply the best Mac keyboard you can use today.

Low key travel spaces and scissor mechanisms form this keyboard’s core lead to a precise typing experience. Moreover, it’s got an extended layout with arrow keys and dedicated document scrolling keys for a great user experience.

Additionally, it comes with a rechargeable battery. You don’t have to worry about the battery, though. Since it pairs seamlessly with MacBooks, the battery usage is highly optimized. However, the price factor could put off a lot of potential customers.

Pros

  • Compatible with all Mac devices
  • Good battery life
  • Great build quality
  • Excellent typing experience

Cons

  • Too expensive

Check out on: Amazon

2. Logitech MX Keys advanced keyboard – Best low-profile keyboard

  • Connectivity – Wireless
  • Weight – 1.9lbs

When you lay your eyes on this offering by Logitech, you’ll understand why it’s one of the best Mac keyboards. The spherically dished keys ensure that you get a beautiful typing experience.

Working with this keyboard is extremely convenient, as it can detect your hand’s proximity and automatically light up. This ensures that you don’t have to worry about working in low light, and your typing will be as accurate as ever. Since it pairs with three different devices simultaneously, it doesn’t interrupt your workflow.

The keyboard also comes with a 1-year warranty.

Pros

  • Hand proximity detection
  • Good Bluetooth connectivity
  • Climate Pledge friendly
  • 1-year warranty

Cons

  • Build quality could be better

Check out on: Amazon | Best Buy

3. Logitech ERGO K860 – Excellent ergonomics

  • Connectivity – USB
  • Weight – 2.56lbs

While some keyboards make minor changes for better ergonomics, what if the entire keyboard’s form factor was changed to accommodate the perfect ergonomics? You don’t have to wonder much about it with the Logitech ERGO K860.

Almost immediately, the keyboard’s shape will startle you. The curved keyframe reduces the stress on your hands and wrist so that you can work more efficiently. Besides, the keys are scooped for better finger posture, and the palm rest can be adjusted to your comfort. If you face serious wrist issues when typing, you should try this keyboard.

The keyboard is also Climate Pledge Friendly, with 71 percent of the keyboard made from post-consumer recycled plastic. Unfortunately, you’ll have to get on a cleaning job quite often with this keyboard. The provided wrist rest can get dirty easily.

Pros

  • Ergonomic design
  • Climate Pledge Friendly
  • Adjustable palm rest

Cons

  • Accumulates dirt easily
  • Bulky

Check out on: Amazon | Best Buy

4. iClever BK10 – Pairs with 3 devices simultaneously

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Weight – 1.11lbs

Sometimes, you need a keyboard for MacBook Pro or Air that doesn’t burn a hole in your wallet. For these situations, you can check out the iClever BK10.

Don’t be fooled by its aggressive pricing. The build quality of the keyboard is much better than you’d expect. Moreover, its Bluetooth technology is good enough to pair with three devices simultaneously. The battery life on the keyboard is decent too, with the company claiming that it can provide 90 hours of continuous typing.

While this is a slim keyboard, its looks are purely functional. However, if you’re looking for an elegant design, this keyboard won’t provide it.

Pros

  • Decent pricing
  • Pairs with three devices simultaneously
  • Great battery life
  • Slim form factor

Cons

  • Isn’t the quietest keyboard

Check out on: Amazon

5. KLIM Chroma – Comes with a 5-year warranty

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Weight – 1.06lbs

If you’re looking for aesthetics, this KLIM Chroma keyboard is for you. This inexpensive, RGB-backlit keyboard for Mac delivers all the fundamentals.

The low actuation distance on the keyboard allows for faster typing speeds and reaction times in online games. It’s also easy to install. You need to plug in the USB receiver, and done! No need to install any drivers.

Here’s the kicker – it has FIVE years’ warranty! That’s right. While you’re not paying a premium for the product, the five-year warranty makes it future-proof as a secondary gaming keyboard.

However, people have reported that the Bluetooth connectivity isn’t the best. To maintain a stable connection, you’ll have to stay close to the USB receiver.

Pros

  • Low actuation distance leads to a good typing experience
  • Easy to set up
  • 5-year warranty

Cons

  • Bluetooth connectivity has some issues

Check out on: Amazon

6. Keychron K2 – Best mechanical keyboard

  • Connectivity – Wireless, Wired
  • Weight – 2.2lbs

This 84-key device from Keychron provides a compact form factor while keeping the best facets of a gaming keyboard. Although it doesn’t look like a gaming keyboard at first glance, its features will win over even the most skeptical gamers.

It also has all the necessary Mac function keys, an aluminum frame for toughness, and RGB lighting for the aesthetics. Gateron Mechanical keys ensure that even the most intense gaming sessions don’t wear out the keycaps. Lastly, the battery life on this mechanical keyboard is simply amazing, with a massive 4000mAh battery.

The keyboard isn’t the best for typing, however. The keys are quite tall and will lower your typing speeds. But if you’re used to this design, you won’t like anything other than this!

Pros

  • Perfect for competitive gamers
  • Mac-based key layout
  • 4000mAh battery gives it a long life
  • Decent build quality

Cons

  • Tall keys might hamper typing speed

Check out on: Amazon | Keychron

7. Macally – Magic Keyboard-like design

  • Connectivity – Wireless
  • Weight – 0.93lbs

This ultra-slim keyboard from Macally is perfect if you’re looking for a Mac keyboard that doesn’t try anything extravagant in the design department. It looks and feels efficient.

The keyboard comes full size, with 110 keys for 20 shortcut keys, a number pad, and all the required presets. Moreover, it’s only 15 millimeters thick, making it extremely sleek and lightweight. You can connect with up to three devices simultaneously for seamless workflow as well.

The power-saving feature in the keyboard isn’t all that great, though. If it’s not in use for a while, it powers off. This can be annoying for most people.

Pros

  • Sleek and minimalist design
  • Full-size keyboard with all the Mac shortcut keys
  • Lightweight

Cons

  • Decal on key designations come off quickly

Check out on: Amazon

8. OMOTON – Value for money

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Weight – 0.75lbs

If you want a keyboard that provides compatibility, ergonomics, and a good design aesthetic without costing you a fortune, the OMOTON keyboard is what you need. This Bluetooth keyboard also has a smaller form factor, making it easy to carry.

Not only is the keyboard priced well, but it’s also compatible with a range of Apple Mac products. You can connect the keyboard with many Apple devices, from Mac Pro to the iMac. It’s also got 12 shortcut keys placed according to the macOS user experience for maximum efficiency.

It’s not a silent operator, however. The keys make some noise when you’re typing.

Pros

  • Compatible with all Mac devices
  • Compact form
  • Plenty of Mac shortcut keys

Cons

  • Tends to be noisy when in use

Check out on: Amazon

9. Das Keyboard 4 – Durability champion

  • Connectivity – USB
  • Weight – 2.90lbs

The Das Keyboard 4 is one of the most durable mechanical keyboards for Mac that you can find on the market. Its tough frame is complemented by the Cherry MX Brown keys for an excellent user experience.

Apart from the durable shell and tactile keys, you also get an N-Key Rollover and a couple of USB 3.0 ports for data transfer. Additionally, all the essential Mac shortcuts are on the keyboard, along with dedicated media controls and a noticeable volume knob. Basically, whether you’re a workaholic or an audiophile, the keyboard fits both bills perfectly.

Unfortunately, this durability comes at a cost. The Das Keyboard 4 is exceptionally heavy, thanks to the hard frame and full size.

Pros

  • Highly durable
  • High-speed USB 3.0 ports for transferring data
  • Dedicated media controls and Mac shortcut keys

Cons

  • Extremely heavy

Check out on: Amazon | Best Buy

The takeaway

So, these were my picks for the best keyboards for MacBook Pro, Air, or any other Mac. I’ve tried to include keyboards for multiple budgets and use cases. Hopefully, it’ll be easier to make a purchasing decision if you’re in the market for an external keyboard for Mac.

If there are any of your favorite keyboards that haven’t been listed here, let me know in the comments below!

Read more:

  • Best mechanical keyboards for Mac
  • Best gaming accessories for Mac
  • How to type special characters and symbols on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

title.rendered: How to fix it when Find My iPhone isn’t working

content.rendered:
Apple’s Find My feature is a lifesaver, as it lets you track your Apple devices and share your location with your contacts. You can also remotely erase your iPhone’s data if it’s lost or stolen via Find My. As such, it can be quite frustrating when Find My iPhone isn’t working as expected. But don’t worry! Here are some common reasons why this might happen and how you can fix it easily.

Tip Before you jump into troubleshooting, ensure you’ve set up the Find My app properly. Don’t know how? Check out our step-by-step guide on how to use Find My app on iPhone and iPad for a detailed walkthrough.
Table of Contents
  • Why is my Find My iPhone not working?
  • 9 ways to fix Find My iPhone not working
    • Check the internet connection
    • Make sure Location Services are enabled
    • Turn off and on Find My iPhone
    • Restart your iPhone
    • Remove your Apple ID and sign back in
    • Reset Network Settings
    • Turn off Low Power Mode
    • Check Date & Time settings
    • Update your iPhone

Why is my Find My iPhone not working?

There could be several reasons why Find My iPhone isn’t working. Here are a few common culprits:

  • Misconfigured Find My settings
  • Weak or no internet connection
  • Location Services are disabled
  • iCloud isn’t synced properly
  • Incorrect date and time settings
  • System glitches
  • Outdated iOS version
  • Find My server outage
  • No SIM in the iPhone

Now that we know the possible reasons, let’s explore the solutions.

9 ways to fix Find My iPhone not working

Find My is turned on automatically when you set up iCloud on your iPhone, so you can keep track of it by logging into iCloud from anywhere. However, if you can’t locate your iPhone or Apple accessories or your location isn’t updating on Find My map, you should try the following fixes to fix it.

1. Check the internet connection

Find My requires a stable internet connection to update your iPhone’s location in real-time. But if your iPhone is offline or the internet connection is weak, it may not work, and you’ll see the last known location of your iPhone.

As such, it’s important to make sure you’re connected to a strong Wi-Fi or cellular network when Find My isn’t working. Open Settings and select Wi-Fi or Cellular and check if you’re online. You may also toggle on and off Airplane Mode to refresh your network connectivity.

Moreover, ensure Find My is allowed to access cellular data. To verify this:

  1. Navigate to Settings and select Cellular.
  2. Scroll down and tap on Show All.
  3. Now, toggle on Find My.

2. Make sure Location Services are enabled

Find My needs access to your iPhone’s location to function. If Location Services are turned off, the app won’t be able to track your device and show no location found alert. Follow these steps to fix this:

  1. Go to Settings and select Privacy & Security.
  2. Tap Location Services and ensure it’s toggled on.

  3. Scroll down, tap Find My, and select While Using the App.
  4. Here, toggle on Precise Location.

This method fixes the Find My location unavailable issue and shows the proper location on the map.

3. Turn off and on Find My iPhone

Sometimes, a quick reset of the Find My service can remove the glitches and resolve the issue. To do this, you need to turn off Find My iPhone first and then enable it.

  1. Launch Settings, tap on your Apple ID at the top, and select Find My.

  2. Tap Find My iPhone and toggle it off.

  3. Enter your Apple ID password and tap Turn Off at the top right corner.

  4. Wait for a few seconds and toggle Find My iPhone on.

While here, turn on the Find My Network and Send Last Location options. These settings help you track your iPhone even if it’s offline, in Low Power mode, and switched off.

4. Restart your iPhone

A simple restart can work wonders in fixing minor glitches that might be causing Find My to misbehave on your iPhone.

  1. Press and hold the Side button and either volume button until you see the power-off slider.
  2. Drag the slider to the right to turn off the device. Wait for a while, then turn it back on.

Need more help? Here’s a guide on how to restart your iPhone or iPad.

5. Remove your Apple ID and sign back in

Sometimes, your Apple ID may fail to sync properly with iCloud, causing issues with Find My. In this case, you can sign out your Apple ID and sign back in. Ensure you’re using the correct Apple ID which you have used to set up your iCloud.

  1. Go to Settings and tap your Apple ID banner at the top.
  2. Scroll down and tap Sign Out.

  3. Enter your password and tap Turn Off.
  4. Toggle on the data you want to keep and tap Sign Out.

  5. Restart your iPhone.
  6. Sign back in with your Apple ID and password.

6. Reset Network Settings

If nothing seems to work, maybe the network settings of your iPhone have become corrupted, causing Find My location tracking to not working properly. You can reset your iPhone’s Network Settings to fix this:

  1. Open Settings, go to General, and select Transfer or Reset iPhone.
  2. Tap Reset and select Reset Network Settings.

  3. Enter your passcode and confirm.

This will erase saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords, so make sure you know them before proceeding.

7. Turn off Low Power Mode

Find My keeps note of your iPhone’s battery status. If you’re running out of power or using Low Power Mode, Find My may struggle to track your live location. Moreover, Low Power Mode limits background processes, which may prevent Find My from working correctly. So, it’s wise to disable Low Power Mode.

  1. Launch Settings and tap on Battery.
  2. Toggle off Low Power Mode.

8. Check Date & Time settings

Incorrect date and time settings can cause syncing issues with iCloud and fail to send accurate location signals. Therefore, ensure your iPhone clock is running correctly.

  1. Go to Settings, select General, and tap Date & Time.
  2. Toggle on Set Automatically.

9. Update your iPhone

Apple frequently releases updates to fix bugs and improve performance. An outdated iOS might be the reason Find My iPhone isn’t working. So, check if any new iOS version is available and update your iPhone.

  1. Navigate to Settings > General > Software Update.

  2. If you see a new update, tap Install Now.

Signing off…

I hope one of these solutions helped you fix the Find My iPhone not working issue on your iPhone. Staying connected to this Apple service can save you a lot of trouble in case your device goes missing. If none of these solutions work, contact Apple Support for further assistance.

FAQs

Why can’t I see my family members’ location on Find My?

Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

Why is location tracking not working on my iPhone?

Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it’s enabled.

Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device’s security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

  • How Apple’s Find My network works: The ultimate guide
  • How to find your lost AirPods in any scenario
  • How to find my Apple Watch if lost or dead
  • How to pause your location in the Find My app on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Does iPhone lens protector affect picture quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. If you apply it correctly, the iPhone camera lens protector will not interfere with your image. So, while installing, check that there is no dust or lint on the lens. Also, handle the lens protector with care, so it doesn't get severe scratches.

mainEntity.name: Are iPhone camera lens protectors worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many claim that lens protectors are not essential since the iPhone's rear cameras are made of sapphire. It is robust and difficult to scratch. So, lens protectors are only for extra caution and decoration of your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple recommend lens protectors?

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

mainEntity.name: Why is location tracking not working on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it's enabled.

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

title.rendered: 5 Best iPad Mini Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple’s default iPad Mini SmartCover does an excellent job of keeping your iPad Mini safe. That’s as far as the screen is concerned. If you are overwhelmed or surprised by the SmartCover, you should remember that it’s not “complete protection.” No offense, but Apple’s SmartCover isn’t a good deal for $40. The market is inundated with plenty of cases for the iPad Mini. You’d probably find one from every large brand like Otterbox (which has a Defender Series for iPad Mini) or Case-Mate. However, we’ve set our sights on a handful of iPad mini cases that satisfy our rules for the iPad mini.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Ztotop
  • 2. OtterBox DEFENDER SERIES
  • 3. Elegant Choise
  • 4. Dteck
  • 5. JETech

1. Ztotop

Looking for a classy folio case for your iPad Mini? Ztotop should be a pretty good option.

The cover is made of high-quality synthetic leather and features a large front pocket to let you store cards and cash securely. With the soft interior lining, it can also absorb shock.

With the two anti-slip grooves, you can enjoy hands-free media watching. Moreover, Ztotop iPad Mini case comes in eight beautiful color options including the brown, black, red and more.

USP: Classy design
Check out on Amazon

2. OtterBox DEFENDER SERIES

Is uncompromised protection for your iPad Mini right on top of your radar? Why not go for OtterBox DEFENDER SERIES that has got an exceptionally robust casing.

The case features triple layers of defense to provide reliable protection to your tablet. However, the best thing about this cover is that it doesn’t look bulky at all.

The shield stand ensures you have a more comfortable hands-free experience. Plus, the built-in screen guard offers the additional defense to the large screen.

USP: Built-in kickstand
Check out on Amazon

3. Elegant Choise

Elegant Choise is designed to be a stylish protective case. Just like DEFENDER SERIES, it also features triple layers of structure to withstand shock.

The anti-slip exterior provides the much-needed grip, while the responsive buttons offer tactile feedback.

Plus, it has a built-in stand to improve your hands-free experience. Moreover, the Elegant Choise protective case comes in seven attractive color combinations.

USP: Shock-absorbing design
Check out on Amazon

4. Dteck

How about picking out a captivating designer case for your tablet? Dteck is beautifully designed and comes in tons of vibrant colors with gorgeous patterns. So, if you are hunting for a show stopper, you may not have to look beyond.

The case is carved out of soft PU leather and has a smooth interior to resist minor impact. With the stand feature, you can use the front cover to position the tablet in landscape mode to watch movies comfortably. Moreover, this folio case also features three card slots and a money pocket.

USP: Attractive pattern
Check out on Amazon

5. JETech

Should you wish to present your iPad Mini a slim case, give a try to JETech. The case looks pretty compact and fits snugly around the tablet.

The PU leather exterior feels pleasant to the touch and also offers enhanced grip. With the sturdy PC casing, it can also endure accidental falls.

Magnetic closure supports auto sleep/wake functionality to extend the battery life of your tablet. Besides, JETech is available in seven enchanting color options such as, blue, green, black and more.

USP: Slim design
Check out on Amazon

That’s all, folks! I think you have enjoyed exploring the iPad Mini covers with me.

Your pick?

So, it’s your turn now to let us know about your favorite case for the iPad. If you would like to include any case in the above lineup, do tell us about that as well.

Don’t miss out on the below roundups as well:

  • 12.9-inch iPad Pro Keyboard Cases
  • Best 12.9-inch iPad Pro Folio Cases

Which is your favorite iPad case maker and why? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

mainEntity.name: Does iPhone lens protector affect picture quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. If you apply it correctly, the iPhone camera lens protector will not interfere with your image. So, while installing, check that there is no dust or lint on the lens. Also, handle the lens protector with care, so it doesn't get severe scratches.

mainEntity.name: Are iPhone camera lens protectors worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many claim that lens protectors are not essential since the iPhone's rear cameras are made of sapphire. It is robust and difficult to scratch. So, lens protectors are only for extra caution and decoration of your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple recommend lens protectors?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no official statement from Apple about this. Using a lens protector depends on how you handle your iPhone. If it remains in your pockets along with keys, you should definitely consider using it.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

mainEntity.name: Why is location tracking not working on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it's enabled.

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple’s iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max are beacons of innovation and excellence in the fast-paced world of smartphones. Our cutting-edge camera system captures life’s precious moments. However, to ensure that the lenses of your iPhone remain pristine, it’s vital to safeguard them with protectors. Let’s explore some of the best camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen camera lens screen protector – Editor's Choice
  • 2. ESR camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 Pro Max
  • 3. amFilm bubble free camera lens protector
  • 4. JETech camera lens protector for iPhone 15 Pro Max
  • 5. TORRAS camera lens protector for iPhone 15 Pro Max – Military-grade defense

1. Spigen camera lens screen protector – Editor’s Choice

There is no doubt that Spigen’s camera lens screen protector is one of the best options available on the market for iPhone 15 Pro Max users seeking optimum lens protection. As a result of its exceptional build quality and durability, this particular set of lens protectors stands out.

Boasting tempered glass with extreme hardness, this protector for the iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max protects the camera lenses from scratches, smudges, dust particles, and other potential damages. It further guarantees minimal interference in capturing crystal-clear images and videos.

Thanks to the inclusion of a hassle-free installation kit, you can incorporate these addons onto your device without any hassle. It comprises the necessary tools and guidelines, ensuring a bubble-free result with perfect alignment. In all senses, Spigen delivers peace of mind for every iPhone user who heavily relies on their iPhone’s camera capabilities.

Pros

  • Climate pledge friendly
  • Precise fit
  • Case friendly
  • Color variation

Cons

  • Light issue after installing

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 Pro Max

Protecting the valuable camera lens of this high-end device is easier than ever with ESR camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max. Known for its uncompromising commitment to quality, ESR provides an exquisitely crafted lens protector that guarantees perfect alignment and maintains image clarity.

The iPhone 15 Pro Max’s camera is effectively shielded from scratches, impacts, and dust by these premium screen protectors made from tempered glass. Additionally, the advanced technology minimizes reflections for better photos.

Incredibly thin and strong, ESR’s lens protectors will withstand daily wear and tear. Among the many accessories that professionals demand for their iPhone 15 Pro Max, the ESR camera lens protectors unquestionably meet these high standards.

Pros

  • Ultimate lens protection
  • Easy to apply
  • Widely compatible
  • Tough scratch resistance

Cons

  • Removing the protector is tricky

Check out on Amazon

3. amFilm bubble free camera lens protector

Manufactured with state-of-the-art tempered glass material, the amFilm OneTouch pack for iPhone 15 Pro Max is a worthy competitor. The ultra-advanced accessory offers numerous features that make it stand out from the rest. It offers unmatched protection against scratches, smudges, and accidental impacts.

This easy installation process eliminates bubbles and residue left behind during installation. Its precision-cut design perfectly adapts to fit the dimensions and shape of the iPhone 15 Pro Max lenses, providing seamless functionality and compatibility.

The high-transparency structure also ensures optimal light transmission and crystal-clear images. Its outstanding durability and user-friendly features make the amFilm OneTouch pack an excellent choice for both professionals and enthusiasts.

Pros

  • Patented auto-alignment tech
  • Smudge proof
  • 30-second installation

Cons

  • May reduce the camera quality

Check out on Amazon

4. JETech camera lens protector for iPhone 15 Pro Max

When it comes to protecting the camera lens on your iPhone 15 Pro Max, the JETech camera lens protector stands out as one of the best options available. Featuring high-quality tempered glass construction, this protector ensures optimal clarity while offering exceptional durability and strength.

The JETech lens protector fits perfectly over the camera module, preventing scratches, smudges, and fingerprints from obscuring your images. In addition, its oleophobic coating repels oil and grease, making it easy to wipe off any smears.

This protector is incredibly easy to install with a bubble-free adhesive that securely holds it in place without affecting image quality or hindering camera functionality. When using the JETech camera lens protector for the iPhone 15 Pro Max, you won’t have to worry about damaging the camera lens on your valuable device.

Pros

  • Full coverage protection
  • Snug-Fit
  • Matte metal plate
  • 9H hardness

Cons

  • No variants available

Check out on Amazon

5. TORRAS camera lens protector for iPhone 15 Pro Max – Military-grade defense

Last but not least, let’s finish off in style with TORRAS, a premium lens protector for iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max. Aside from its exceptional durability, it also ensures that lenses remain free of scratches, smudges, and other possible damage.

The ultra-thin design of this accessory ensures a seamless fit without compromising on protection or interfering with the camera functionalities. Moreover, the premium tempered glass infused within delivers unrivaled transparency and clarity to your flagship device. It also preserves the original image quality captured by the iPhone 15 Pro Max’s advanced camera system.

The lens surface is protected from accidental drops, impacts, and dirt accumulation with precise cutouts and edge-to-edge coverage. The oleophobic coating resists fingerprints and smudges for clear viewing at all times. With sturdy construction and optimized attributes, this lens protector ensures lifelong protection for your device.

Pros

  • Adheres securely
  • Resists dust and foggy
  • Fingerprint resistant
  • Case friendly

Cons

  • Very expensive

Check out on Amazon

A perfect blend of protection and clarity!

Your iPhone 15 Pro or Pro Max deserves nothing but the best, and these lens protectors have proven their mettle in safeguarding your device’s most crucial component, its camera. With the right lens protector, you can continue to push the boundaries of your photography and videography skills while keeping your investment safe.

Thank you for reading. Please take a moment to leave your thoughts in the comments below.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

mainEntity.name: Why is location tracking not working on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it's enabled.

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

title.rendered: How to use SharePlay on Apple Music in your car

content.rendered:
Road trips with friends are incomplete without music. To make this experience more fun, Apple Music lets you start a SharePlay session in CarPlay. So, passengers in your car can control the music playback even if they don’t have an Apple Music subscription. In this guide, I’ll show you how to use SharePlay in CarPlay with Apple Music.

What is SharePlay in CarPlay?

SharePlay lets you stream music and videos with your friends and family remotely. To make this feature even more useful, Apple has integrated it with CarPlay. Now, anyone in your car can control the music and contribute to what’s playing while you’re focused on driving safely.

Earlier, if you ever wanted to allow a passenger to play music in your car, you had to either rely on an AUX cable paired with a Lightning to 3.5mm Headphone Jack adapter or connect audio over Bluetooth. While both methods did the trick, they were highly impractical by today’s standards.

Now, SharePlay makes this process a breeze. Whenever you connect your iPhone with CarPlay, it automatically initiates a SharePlay session, allowing nearby Apple devices to join and play music together. What’s great about this is that it even works when passengers aren’t subscribed to Apple Music.

Prerequisites to use SharePlay with CarPlay

Before you can start using SharePlay with CarPlay, make sure you meet these basic requirements:

  • SharePlay with CarPlay is only available on iPhones running iOS 17 or a newer version.
  • Your car or stereo system must support Apple CarPlay.
  • You must have an active Apple Music subscription.
  • Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your iPhone.

If you are a passenger and want to join a SharePlay music session, your iPhone must run the latest iOS version and have Bluetooth turned on.

Moreover, everyone should ensure they are discoverable by their contacts while playing music. To do so, go to Settings, scroll down, tap Apps, and select Music. Then, toggle on Discoverable by Nearby Contacts.

Once you’ve checked these requirements, you’re ready to use SharePlay on Apple Music in your car.

How to start a SharePlay session in CarPlay

There are two convenient methods to start a SharePlay session in CarPlay. Let’s check them out:

Method 1: Use a QR code to start SharePlay

  1. Connect your iPhone to CarPlay either wirelessly or via a USB cable.
  2. Open the Music app on your car’s display running CarPlay.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 
  3. Tap the triangle icon on the top-right to open the Now Playing page.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 
  4. Tap the SharePlay icon in the top-right corner of the screen.
    If you don’t see a QR code, you must tap the QR code icon.


    ‍ 
  5. Open the camera app on the passenger’s device → Scan the QR code.


    ‍ 
  6. Tap the yellow ‘Music’ button that appears above the camera shutter.
  7. Tap Connect once the Music app opens up on the passenger’s device.


    ‍ 
  8. Tap the prompt on your car’s display.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 
  9. Select the Green checkmark icon to start the SharePlay session.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 

Method 2: Start a SharePlay session in your car without a QR code

If you’re traveling with someone whose contact is saved on your iPhone, you can initiate a SharePlay session directly without scanning the QR code.

  1. Open the Music app in CarPlay → go to the Now Playing page.


     
  2. Tap the SharePlay icon in the top-right corner of the screen.


    ‍ 
  3. Toggle on Discoverable by Nearby Contacts if it’s not already enabled.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 
  4. Tap the Tap to join SharePlay prompt on a passenger’s iPhone or iPad.
  5. Tap Connect once the Music app opens up on the passenger’s device.
    ‍ 

    ‍ 
  6. Tap the prompt on your car’s display.


    ‍ 
  7. Select the Green checkmark icon to start the SharePlay session.
    ‍ 

Once you start a SharePlay session in CarPlay, the connected passengers can change the song that’s playing, add tracks to the queue, play or pause the music, turn on shuffle or repeat, and view song lyrics on their iPhones.

Moreover, the contact can connect to your SharePlay music session directly in the future without following the steps each time.

How to join an existing SharePlay session on CarPlay

Adding all passengers in your car to the SharePlay session may seem like a daunting task. But don’t worry! Once you approve one passenger on your car, they can add other passengers to that existing SharePlay session. So you don’t need to manually add them via CarPlay. Here’s how it works:

  1. Open the Music app on a connected device → Go to Now Playing.
  2. Tap the SharePlay icon found below the volume slider.
  3. Scan the QR code using the device that wants to join the session.
    ‍ 

How to stop or leave SharePlay music session on CarPlay

Once you reach your destination, you need to end or leave the SharePlay music session on CarPlay.

Stop SharePlay as the Host

If you’re the one who started the SharePlay session:

  1. Access your CarPlay screen. It should be on the Now Playing
  2. Select End to stop SharePlay for everyone.

Leave SharePlay as a Participant

If you joined a SharePlay session as a passenger:

  1. Open the Now Playing screen in the Apple Music app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap the SharePlay icon at the bottom of your screen.
  3. Select Leave to exit without ending it for others.

Once you leave or end the session, your CarPlay will switch back to regular playback, and you’ll be in full control of the music again.

Wrapping up

SharePlay with CarPlay is a great feature that makes it easier for you to listen to music with your friends and family while you’re traveling together. I hope this how-to guide helped you to set up a SharePlay session in CarPlay. If you have any doubts, leave them in the comments section.

FAQs

Do I need an active internet connection to use SharePlay with CarPlay?

Yes, both the host and the passenger’s device must be connected to the internet via cellular or Personal Hotspot to initiate the SharePlay session and access the Apple Music.

Can SharePlay in CarPlay be used with third-party music apps?

SharePlay in CarPlay is primarily designed to work with Apple Music. While it’s possible for third-party music apps like Spotify to work with SharePlay, they don’t support SharePlay in CarPlay at the time of writing this post.

blockGraphs.question: Can SharePlay in CarPlay be used with third-party music apps?
blockGraphs.answer: SharePlay in CarPlay is primarily designed to work with Apple Music. While it’s possible for third-party music apps like Spotify to work with SharePlay, they don’t support SharePlay in CarPlay at the time of writing this post.

title.rendered: Best HomePod Coasters, Bases, and Mats in 2026

content.rendered:
When your intelligent gadgets begin to grab your guests’ attention at home, you feel satisfied for a moment. But little did you know that sometimes those devices left their nasty marks on the glass or wooden surface. A case in point is Apple’s HomePod, a silicone base that leaves rings on surfaces. So having HomePod bases, mats, and coasters could be a perfect solution to avoid those ugly stains on your tabletops.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Pad & Quill Leather HomePod Coaster
  • 2. KIWI Design Aluminum Alloy Coaster Holder for HomePod
  • 3. LuckyNV Natural Leather Waterproof HomePod Mat
  • 4. CIRCLE TECH Aluminum Alloy HomePod Coaster
  • 5. LANMU Silicone Anti-Slip Pad for HomePod
  • 6. Casa Bellante Leather Coaster for HomePod

1. Pad & Quill Leather HomePod Coaster

Pad & Quill is known to manufacture luxurious Apple accessories. This leather HomePod coaster is the best surface protector for you. Pad & Quill has used American full grain leather to manufacture this state-of-the-art surface protection for HomePod. This ultra-soft leather mat is available in three beautiful colors: whiskey, chestnut, and galloper black.

Marine grade stitching of leather base imparts exquisite finesse to this product. Pad & Quill has achieved new heights in minimalist arts by crafting this surface protection for HomePod.

USP: Marine grade stitching

2. KIWI Design Aluminum Alloy Coaster Holder for HomePod

KIWI Design has crafted a durable HomePod coaster from aluminum. The material is strong enough to protect your smart speaker; the design of this coaster will never destroy your HomePod. You can install this coaster anywhere in your house – kitchen, bathroom or bedroom.

Design of this aluminum coaster is simple, and therefore it creates a remarkable sophistication in your living room. A mixture of stainless steel and aluminum alloy ensures that your HomePod does not roll down from the flat surface.

USP: Flexible and durable
Check out on Amazon

3. LuckyNV Natural Leather Waterproof HomePod Mat

A leather mat for your Apple HomePod is a beautiful home décor piece. Enhance your home and office’s aesthetic elements by placing your smart speaker on the mat, which is made of natural leather. This waterproof mat is one of the best accessories for your intelligent speaker.

LuckyNV has crafted this mat from cowhide material, which protects the sound. Anti-knock quality of this leather mat keeps damage at bay. You can use your HomePod without any worry.

USP: Cowhide material
Check out on Amazon

4. CIRCLE TECH Aluminum Alloy HomePod Coaster

Sporting a compact form-factor, Circle is worth considering for three reasons. First and foremost, the stand is made of high-grade aluminum alloy which endows durability while also giving it a modern look.

The second, it fits HomePod pretty well and also resists vibrations. And with the anti-slip pad, it remains steady on any surface. As for price, Circle coaster is a bit expensive at $21.88. But considering the specs, it’s overall a good deal.

USP: High-grade aluminum alloy construction
Check out on Amazon

5. LANMU Silicone Anti-Slip Pad for HomePod

Featuring a soft and scratch-resistant design, LANMU can offer the needed care to your HomePod. For one, the pad is made of silicone material and is fully capable of absorbing vibrations. Thus, it shields the smart speaker against scuffs and ensures the pure sound is not compromised.

The coaster sports a flat rubber base so that the speaker can fit snuggly. Another feature worth noting is that it also doesn’t leave behind any white rings on wooden furniture. Lastly, LANMU comes at $7.99 for one pack and $12.99 for a two-pack, making it one of the cheapest coasters for HomePod.

USP: Flat rubberized base
Check out on Amazon

6. Casa Bellante Leather Coaster for HomePod

Another HomePod coaster made of genuine leather. This time it is from Casa Bellante, which has manufactured state-of-the-art coaster. Casa Bellante has used 100% genuine leather to produce an ultra-soft coaster with artisan signature.

Casa Bellante has deliberately kept a low profile to highlight the modern design of the coaster. You will get a set of two coasters for your Apple HomePod.

USP: Ultra-soft leather
Check out on Amazon

That’s it!

Signing off…

HomePod mats or coasters are one of the essential accessories for your smart speaker. Since you invest a lot of money in your smart speaker, you need to protect the device from every side. Aside from covers and mounts, HomePod bases should be on the top of your list.

You may also like to explore:

  • Best Accessories for HomePod and HomePod Mini
  • How to use HomePod and HomePod Mini with Mac
  • HomePod mini 2: Everything We Know So Far

Which HomePod base would you like the most? Do share your feedback in comment section.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it's enabled.

title.rendered: Best MagSafe stands for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
MagSafe continues to be Apple lovers’ favorite part of the ecosystem. One of them is the MagSafe stands for iPhone, whose popularity has skyrocketed with iOS 17’s StandBy mode.   

These sleek, magnetic add-ons bring seamless charging, convenience, and ergonomic brilliance to your work desks. Here, I’ve shared some of the best MagSafe stands that excel in design, performance, and utility.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen Mag Fit S MagSafe stand – Editor's Choice
  • 2. ESR wireless charger with Kickstand – Travel buddy
  • 3. Anker PowerWave 2-in-1 Magnetic Stand Lite – Compact
  • 4. Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 Charging Stand
  • 5. UGREEN 2-in-1 MagSafe charging stand – Tabletop friend
  • 6. Anker 622 Magnetic Battery (MagGo) – Everyday essential
  • 7. Twelve South HiRise 3 MagSafe stand – Charge two iPhones
  • 8. Rueseio 3-in-1 MagSafe stand – Safe charging

1. Spigen Mag Fit S MagSafe stand – Editor’s Choice

If you already have a MagSafe wireless charger and want to juice your iPhone while in FaceTime, streaming, or StandBy mode, get a Spigen Mag Fit charger stand. This flexible stand features a sleek, lightweight, and compact aluminum build.

In addition, the grip pads and Nanotec technology ensure the stand sits firmly when placed on flat surfaces. The foldable mounting system lets you place your iPhone in different viewing angles. You can put your iPhone in portrait or landscape orientation with a single adjustment.

If you use StandBy mode regularly, you will love the ease this stand will bring in using this feature. Also, you can add these StandBy widgets for a more seamless experience. Besides, the Mag Fit S stand is designed exclusively for MagSafe chargers.

Once you attach your wireless charger to the stand, you can enjoy uninterrupted charging for the iPhone. Also, you can adjust the stand to power your AirPods. Plus, you can fold the stand and keep it in your bag during travel.  

Pros

  • Steady aluminum frame  
  • Can charge AirPods  
  • Foldable for multiple views 

Cons

  • Adjustment issues with camera bump 

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR wireless charger with Kickstand – Travel buddy 

I won’t exaggerate when I say this MagSafe charger from ESR is a revolution. Why? The credit goes to its smart design, which comprises a compact circular frame with a built-in kickstand.

This on-demand kickstand pops out, enabling you to place your iPhone anywhere and enjoy StandBy mode during charging. With a lightweight aluminum frame, the ESR wireless charger makes it easy to carry around in your backpack or even handbag.

In addition, the product features advanced heat management technology that promises full charge in as little as 2.5 hours. Further, the ESR kickstand charger comes with a 5ft long USB-C cable. So you can move around while charging your iPhone.  

Pros

  • On-demand kickstand 
  • Handy and portable 
  • Innovative heat management  

Cons

  • Overheating issue 
  • Less durable 

Check out on Amazon

3. Anker PowerWave 2-in-1 Magnetic Stand Lite – Compact

The Anker PowerWave MagSafe charging stand perfectly balances style and performance. Where the snap-on pad aligned on the stem charges your iPhone, the base powers up your case-enclosed AirPods.

The solid design and steady magnetic connection hold your devices firmly, ensuring efficient charging. Promising ease of use, the charging stand has LEDs on the charging base displaying the charging status.

The white light shows active charging, while the flashing white indicates interruptions. In addition, you will also get a 5ft long USB-C charging cable for easy connectivity.  

The PowerWave MagSafe stand supports landscape viewing positions, perfect for enabling the StandBy mode on your iPhone. Moreover, you can customize the viewing angle up to 40 degrees and enjoy the best streaming experience.

Pros

  • Custom set viewing angle up to 40° 
  • LEDs showing charge status 
  • Strong magnets  
  • Slim and lightweight build 

Cons

  • Expensive  

Check out on Amazon

4. Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 Charging Stand 

Can’t manage simultaneous charging of your Apple Trinity? No worries, the Belkin MagSafe 3-in-1 charging stand is your savior. This power beast provides optimized charging support for the iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods.   

The stand features a T-shape and offers fast charging of up to 15W for iPhone 12 and up models. The 33% fast charging support is also available for Apple Watch Series 7 and subsequent variants.

Besides, the perfectly aligned magnets provide quick and efficient charging anywhere and anytime. In addition, the smart architectural design of the Belkin 3-in-1 charging stand is ideal for resting your iPhone in different orientations.

You can freely attend FaceTime calls in portrait mode and use StandBy in landscape. Plus, it doesn’t consume enough space, making it ideal to place on bedside desks, coffee tables, and corners.  

Pros

  • Charges 3 devices at once 
  • Smart design  
  • Ideal for StandBy mode 
  • Fast charging for iPhone and Apple Watch 

Cons

  • A bit expensive

Check out on Amazon

5. UGREEN 2-in-1 MagSafe charging stand – Tabletop friend

If you plan to add a new charging accessory to your collection, you cannot miss UGREEN’s 2-in-1 charging station. The charger features a solid magnetic lock system comprising 8 N52H magnets, giving 700g of magnetic force.

Therefore, it swiftly holds your iPhone in place and offers charging of 7.5W for iPhone and 5W for AirPods. For design, the charging station features a sleek frame that doesn’t consume extra space.

In addition, a ball joint made of aluminum alloy makes it easy to adjust the stand at multiple angles. Similarly, the 360° rotatable magnetic ring lets you easily switch between landscape and portrait modes.   

Like most chargers, the UGREEN 2-in-1 stand has an LED indicator displaying active charging status. Plus, the USB-C connectivity ensures you don’t struggle to find the right port for the charger stand. 

Pros

  • Smart magnetic lock 
  • Safe charging for iPhone and AirPods 
  • 360° rotatable magnetic ring 

Cons

6. Anker 622 Magnetic Battery (MagGo) – Everyday essential

Snap, charge, and go – with the stylish Anker 622 magnetic battery charger. The 5,000mAh battery of this power bank gives a maximum 7.5W charging support to your iPhone. However, you won’t find it here if you are looking for fast charging.   

The small size of this handy charger might make you doubt its competence. However, the charger features Anker’s Mini Cell technology that promises top-notch performance in its tiny frame.

Feel free to carry your iPhone snapped on the 0.5” thick MagSafe battery pack without messing with the charging and burdening your hand. Another big USP of this MagGo charger is the built-in foldable stand attached to its rear side.

You can pull it out to place your iPhone in StandBy mode or when you want to go hands-free. Lastly, the super strong magnets hold your iPhone firmly, giving a stable power push. 

Pros

  • Attached foldable stand 
  • Strong magnetic support 
  • Small-sized and portable 

Cons

  • Overheating might occur 
  • Doesn’t charge 100%

7. Twelve South HiRise 3 MagSafe stand – Charge two iPhones

Apple lovers meet Twelve South HiRise 3 Deluxe charging stand with MagSafe. The product features a stylish frame made of aluminum and a soft leather-wrapped Qi base that gives a premium look. Plus, its vertical design doesn’t consume space on your tables or desks.    

It is ideal for simultaneously charging iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Additionally, you get fast charging support at 15W for iPhone, 5W for Apple Watch, and 7.5W for AirPods. FYI, the Qi charging base will also charge a second iPhone (8 and up) instead of AirPods.  

Like its competitors, the Twelve South HiRise 3 Deluxe lets you place your iPhone in multiple angles. You can tilt the frame by 35 degrees and switch between different orientations. This makes it ideal for the StandBy mode in iOS 17.

Pros

  • 35-degree tilt

  • Doesn’t consume much space 
  • Can support charge for two iPhones 

Cons

8. Rueseio 3-in-1 MagSafe stand – Safe charging  

Say hello to another 3-in-1 MagSafe charger with a stand. This one is from Rueseio and specializes in making your charging seamless and convenient.

Adorning a sleek design, the charging pad lets you securely snap your iPhone on and increase charging efficiency by 25%. This multi-device charger powers your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously.

FYI, it offers a power boost of up to 7.5W for iPhone, 3W for Apple Watch, and 5W for AirPods. Moreover, the 360-degree rotatable build lets you use it for streaming, playing games, or enabling StandBy. 

Created using CNC technology, the Rueseio charging stand features an aluminum frame. Moreover, the smart safety algorithm controls temperature and provides complete protection from issues like short circuits, excess current flow, and voltage.   

Pros

  • Exclusive safety technology 
  • 360-degree rotation 
  • Increased charging efficiency 
  • Aluminum frame reduces heating 

Cons

Keeping your iPhone elevated with MagSafe stands for desk might be a small change, but it’s noteworthy. First, it creates extra space on your desk, and second, it makes your iPhone handy.

So, it’s time you pick a MagSafe stand from this list and experience the difference. This list is likely to fit your tastes. Also, if you already have a favorite, share it in the comments section.

mainEntity.name: Does iPhone lens protector affect picture quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. If you apply it correctly, the iPhone camera lens protector will not interfere with your image. So, while installing, check that there is no dust or lint on the lens. Also, handle the lens protector with care, so it doesn't get severe scratches.

mainEntity.name: Are iPhone camera lens protectors worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many claim that lens protectors are not essential since the iPhone's rear cameras are made of sapphire. It is robust and difficult to scratch. So, lens protectors are only for extra caution and decoration of your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I see my family members' location on Find My?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure both you and your family members have enabled Location Sharing. Go to Settings > Apple ID > Find My and toggle on Share My Location. Then get back to Apple ID settings, select Family, tap Location Sharing, and verify the family member is toggled on.

mainEntity.name: Why is location tracking not working on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check your internet connection and ensure that Location Services are enabled for the Find My app. Also, turn off Low Power Mode if it's enabled.

mainEntity.name: Why does Find My iPhone say no location found?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can face the Find My iPhone no location found error if your iPhone is turned off, has no internet connection, or Location Services are disabled. Ensure that all these settings are correctly configured. To enhance your device's security, you may also turn on Stolen Device Protection.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an active internet connection to use SharePlay with CarPlay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both the host and the passenger’s device must be connected to the internet via cellular or Personal Hotspot to initiate the SharePlay session and access the Apple Music.

mainEntity.name: Can SharePlay in CarPlay be used with third-party music apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: SharePlay in CarPlay is primarily designed to work with Apple Music. While it’s possible for third-party music apps like Spotify to work with SharePlay, they don’t support SharePlay in CarPlay at the time of writing this post.
