title.rendered: Best Apple Watch Series 9 cases in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple’s latest smartwatch, the Apple Watch Series 9, is an outstanding device with plenty of features to offer. To ensure its long-term functionality and look, it’s important to protect it with a case. If you agree with me, here’s a list of some of the best Apple Watch Series 9 cases on the market!

The Apple Watch Series 9, 8, and 7 share the same design, so most cases in this list will be compatible with these models. However, you’ll need to check if the case you like is available in your Apple Watch’s dial size. Now, let’s get started!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen Tough Armor case – Editor's Choice
  • 2. PITAKA slim Apple Watch case
  • 3. CASETiFY Impact case Apple Watch series 9
  • 4. Otterbox case for Apple Watch Series 9
  • 5. Ringke Air Sports Case
  • 6. RHINOSHIELD Bumper Case
  • 7. elkson rugged case for Apple Watch Series 9
  • 8. SwitchEasy aluminum case

1. Spigen Tough Armor case – Editor’s Choice

The Spigen Tough Armor Case is the ultimate defense for your Apple Watch Series 9. It’s triple-layered with a built-in screen protector to withstand even the most brutal bumps. The precise cutouts let you use all the features of your Apple Watch without compromises. The durable yet sleek finish of the case gives your Apple Watch a stylish look while protecting it from damage.

With the Spigen Tough Armor Case, you can rest assured knowing that your Apple Watch is well-protected. The case is designed to absorb impact and protect your Apple Watch from damage, even in the event of a fall. Whether you are at the gym, on a hike, or just running errands, you can be confident that your Apple Watch is safe and sound.

Pros

  • Has a built-in screen protector
  • Raised edges around the screen

Cons

  • Only covers the front side
  • Only Available in a single color

Check out on Amazon: 45mm | 41 mm

2. PITAKA slim Apple Watch case

The PITAKA Air Case is the perfect way to protect your Apple Watch from scratches, drops, and bumps without adding any bulk or weight. With a weight of only 0.02oz (0.6 grams) and a thickness of 0.7mm, this ultra-slim case is virtually invisible on your wrist. The PITAKA Air Case is made from 600D aramid fiber. This makes the case incredibly durable and able to withstand even the most active lifestyles while ensuring all-day comfort.

This Case is precision crafted to fit the Apple Watch Series 9/8/7. It has precise cutouts for all buttons and sensors on the watch so that you can use it without any interference. The case also does not affect wireless charging, so you can charge your watch without removing the case.

Pros

  • Sleek minimalistic design
  • Tough aramid fiber construction

Cons

  • Has a very thin construction
  • Pricier compared to other cases

Check out on Amazon: 45 mm

3. CASETiFY Impact case Apple Watch series 9

The CASETiFY Impact Watch Case is a durable and lightweight case that is designed to protect your Apple Watch Series 9 from accidental bumps and scratches. It’s made using a soft TPU material that offers a matte sandblast finish, giving it a comfortable and grippy feel. Moreover, this case features a raised bezel that should help protect the screen from scratches or cracks.

The CASETiFY Impact Watch Case is very easy to install and remove, and it comes in four different colors, including Black, Gold, Rose Gold, and Silver, to match your style. It’s also compatible with all Apple Watch bands, so you can continue to use your favorite band even with the case on.

Pros

  • Lightweight and sturdy
  • Offers minimalistic looks

Cons

  • Pricier compared to other cases

Check out on: Amazon

4. Otterbox case for Apple Watch Series 9

The Otterbox All Day Case for Apple Watch Series 9 offers an excellent way to safeguard your smartwatch from everyday wear and tear. With its sleek design made from 90% recycled plastic available in 17 different colorways, it complements your Apple Watch and allows all features to work perfectly.

The case’s smooth bumper guards the display, edges, and Crown while the precision fit stays on under impact. Lasting anti-microbial technology helps protect the case exterior against many common bacteria. Whether you’re working out, running errands, or just going about your day, the Otterbox All Day Case should help keep your Apple Watch Series 9 looking its best.

Pros

  • Uses high-quality recycled materials
  • Unique Anti-microbial layer

Cons

  • Has a very thick construction

Check out on Amazon: 45 mm | 41 mm

5. Ringke Air Sports Case

Ringke Air Sports Case protects your Apple Watch Series 9 without adding unwanted bulk or weight. The durable material used in this product withstands even the most active lifestyles. So whether you’re working out, running errands, or just going about your day, you can be sure your Apple Watch is safe and protected.

The Ringke Air Sports Case is a slim and lightweight case that protects your Apple Watch Series 9 from impact and scratches. It’s easy to put on and allows full access to all buttons and sensors. The case is available in five attractive colors, so you can find the perfect match for your watch.

Pros

  • Unique squared-off design
  • Available in five colors

Cons

  • Somewhat on the thicker side
  • It isn’t flexible enough

Check out on: Amazon

6. RHINOSHIELD Bumper Case

The RHINOSHIELD Bumper Case for the Apple Watch Series 9 is a very thin and lightweight case that offers durable protection from bumps, scratches, and drops. It’s crafted from a unique impact-resistant material that can easily withstand drops from up to 1.2 meters. The case also features raised edges around the screen to protect it from scratches and blunt impacts.

The RHINOSHIELD Bumper Case is designed to be as thin and lightweight as possible. It has precise cutouts for the digital crown, heart rate sensor, and wireless charging, letting you use your watch without any hassle. Lastly, this case is available in several colors so you can stylize your Apple watch.

Pros

  • Excellent shock resistance
  • Available in several colors

Cons

  • It isn’t flexible enough

Check out on: Amazon

7. elkson rugged case for Apple Watch Series 9

The elkson Quattro Bumper Case for your Apple Watch is a rugged yet stylish case that provides military-grade protection for Apple Watch Series 9. This case is made with scratch-resistant soft-touch TPU that offers a flexible and shock-resistant structure. It fits snugly and has precise cutouts for all buttons and ports. It also has a raised edge to protect the screen from bumps and scratches.

The Quattro Bumper Case is backward compatible with the Apple Watch Series 9, 8, and 7, so you can even use it with your older Apple watch. This bumper case is also compatible with all charging accessories and watch bands, so you can use your watch without any inherent restrictions.

Pros

  • Uses soft-touch silicone
  • Fits snugly for great protection

Cons

  • Somewhat on the thicker side

Check out on: Amazon

8. SwitchEasy aluminum case

The SwitchEasy case for Apple Watch Series 9 comes in eight different colors with matte or gloss finishes. Designed to prevent scratches, bumps, and drops on your Apple watch, it’s the perfect case. This case features an aviation-grade aluminum shell that can be attached over a soft inner TPU bumper, allowing it to provide military-grade protection for your Apple Watch in the harshest conditions.

Besides offering a well-thought-out military-grade design, the SwitchEasy Odyssey Case also works with most Apple Watch bands and wireless chargers. This means you can quickly switch watch bands or charge your watch without taking off the case. Another great feature of this case is that it’s screen protector friendly, even though it has raised edges for padding.

Pros

  • Premium aluminum design
  • Offers gloss and matte finishes

Cons

  • Can add to the overall weight
  • Might catch scratches over time

Check out on: Amazon

Wrapping up…

Whether you’re looking for a stylish case to complement your Apple Watch Series 9 or a rugged case to withstand the natural elements, the cases we have mentioned in this buying guide should help you find the perfect case to match your needs. If this guide was able to assist you, let us know which case you got for your Apple Watch in the comments below.

Also read:

  • Best Apple Watch Cases (All Series)
  • Best Apple Watch bands (All models)
  • Best cases for Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Best Apple Watch screen protectors

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

title.rendered: Best webcams for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Although your Mac, like most laptops these days, comes with a built-in camera to chat or take photos and videos, it’s not the best resolution and looks noisy and flat. Given how life has changed over the past year and we’re all spending more time than ever on our computers, it’s worthy to invest in a good webcam for Mac.

Whether it’s for work, online school, connecting with friends and family, or streaming content, the right webcam will let you enjoy better video quality and many other features such as depth-sensing technology and enhanced sound quality. I’ve put together this guide with the best webcams for Mac based on your needs.

But first, let’s consider the parameter based on which I curated this list.

Note: Given the high demand for webcams, the best ones we picked out for this list run out of stock pretty quickly. While we update this article regularly, the product may become unavailable in between. So, please check their availability on Amazon.

Table of Content
  • What are the best webcams to buy for your Mac? (Top 9 picks)
    • 1. Dell UltraSharp 4K HDR Webcam – Editor's Choice
    • 2. Logitech Brio – Best Mac webcam with 4K
    • 3. Razer Kiyo – Best streaming webcam
    • 4. Logitech C930e – Best Mac webcam for business meetings
    • 5. Insta360 Link PTZ 4K Webcam – Gesture control and AI tracking
    • 6. Logitech StreamCam Premium Webcam – Ideal for streaming
    • 7. Anker PowerConf C302 – Built-in noise cancellation
    • 8. Creative Live! Cam Sync 4K UHD – Plug and play on Mac
    • 9. OBSBOT Meet AI-Powered 4K Webcam – Low light correction

What are the best webcams to buy for your Mac? (Top 9 picks)

1. Dell UltraSharp 4K HDR Webcam – Editor’s Choice

Why not use all the time at home to get active online? Here’s the best webcam for streaming that allows content creators to record high-quality video for YouTube or other platforms. Enjoy hassle-free streaming thanks to the optimization for Open Broadcaster Software (OBS).

Further, it boasts USB-C for fast video transfer speeds so that you won’t experience lag or stutter from the camera.

One of the standout features is that it supports vertical video, a bonus for influencers whose primary platform is Instagram or Twitter.

Moreover, it comes with the Logitech Capture software that offers many tools that content creators will love. For instance, you can record from two webcams and merge them into a single scene, overlay with text, add transitions, and more.

The 78-degree field of view (FoV) is sufficient for most situations, but you won’t be able to fit in a second person or show off your background as there’s no wide-angle here.
The mic captures your voice pretty well, and you won’t need an external mic setup.

The only downside is that if you have an older Mac without a USB-C port, you will need to use an adapter, which interferes with the webcam’s performance. So I would recommend getting this only if your computer has a USB-C port.

Pros

  • Optimized for OBS
  • Vertical Video support
  • Companion software for content creators

Cons

  • Lack of USB-A-support
  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

2. Logitech Brio – Best Mac webcam with 4K

Logitech’s top-notch webcam, Brio, is the best 4K webcam for Mac, with few others on the market that can match it. It would be most suitable for live streaming or recording super high-quality videos to upload on YouTube or other services.

Moreover, it also offers superb sound and automatically adjusts exposure and contrast to compensate for glare and backlighting.

It’s pretty versatile since it offers multiple connection options, including USB A, C, 2.0, and 3.0. But note that 4K video is only possible with USB 3.0.

Further, it comes with companion software, in which you can manually adjust the field of view from 65, 78, or 90 degrees. You can also adjust the resolution and frame rate and manually zoom up to 5x. Nifty!

However, 4K resolution does not make much sense for video chat because services like Zoom and Skype don’t support it. So, if you are a YouTuber or a content creator, go for it, but not otherwise.

Pros

  • 4K video
  • 5x digital zoom
  • Multiple connection options

Cons

  • USB 3.0 required

Download

3. Razer Kiyo – Best streaming webcam

Live streaming is a great way to stay occupied when spending so much time indoors. And Razer Kiyo is the best webcam for Mac with light to ensure you look your best when making an appearance.

It features a multi-step ring light with adjustable lighting levels that ensures even and flattering light without harsh shadows.

The 720 p resolution at 60 fps maintains visual fidelity during streaming on popular platforms like open broadcaster software and Xsplit. If you want a crisp, sharp image, use 1080p at 30FPS, but to show off the speed and agility of your gaming avatar, reduce the resolution to 720p and ramp up the frames-per-second to 60 to highlight the action with zero lag or skips. This makes Razer’s Kiyo the best webcam for game streaming.

It also has fast and accurate autofocus for seamlessly sharp footage, plus it’s small enough to take with you on travels – always a plus, in my opinion! I especially appreciate how Razer consistently updates the Kiyo to improve performance, making it worth the high price tag.

However, the one downside is that the accompanying software does not work on Mac. So you cannot take advantage of all the customizable settings. Nonetheless, it’s still a pretty great plug-and-play webcam!

Pros

  • Built-in ring light
  • 60 FPS (at 720p)
  • Easy to use
  • Regular firmware updates

Cons

  • Special functions don’t work on Mac

Download

4. Logitech C930e – Best Mac webcam for business meetings

Here’s another Logitech webcam for Mac that’s more affordable than the Brio. Although it does not support 4K, It’s among the best external HD webcams for Mac, particularly for business use.

It works like a charm with some of the most popular video services, including Skype for Business and Cisco. Plus, it boasts enhanced integration with Zoom, BlueJeans, Broadsoft, Vidyo, Zoom, and LifeSize Cloud.

It records at 1920×1080 resolution and 30fps, with autofocus and automatic light correction to ensure sharp image quality as you move around, or even if the light changes. It has two microphones, one on each side of the lens – for stereo audio recordings.

Further, it uses H264 video compression to minimize lag or video skips while on a conference call.

You will need a USB-A port to plug it into and then clip on to your screen. Or, fold it flat and let it sit on your desk or a shelf. The included tripod mount is an added convenience for content creators.

Pros

  • Manual zoom (4x)
  • H264 video compression
  • Good low-light performance

Cons

  • Companion software could be better

Download

5. Insta360 Link PTZ 4K Webcam – Gesture control and AI tracking

The Insta360 Link is a 4K webcam that lets you look and sound great during video calls and live streams. It features a 1/2-inch sensor that allows you to capture horizontal or vertical videos with crisp details and dynamic range. Apart from that, this webcam also supports AI subject tracking and offers a Whiteboard Mode, which can be enabled by using simple hand gestures. 

In addition to its impressive video capabilities, the Insta360 Link also offers dual noise-canceling microphones that help reduce background noise to amplify your voice and deliver crisp audio for enhanced communication. It also comes with an app that lets you manually adjust the gimbal’s position, exposure, brightness, and more so you can get the perfect shot every time.

All in all, features like dual-noise cancellation microphones, AI tracking, and gesture control make the Insta360 Link a great option for professional video conferencing users, content creators, and live streamers alike.

Pros

  • Features dual noise-cancellation microphones
  • Supports both horizontal and vertical video recording

Cons

  • Priced very aggressively
  • Lacks any kind of privacy cover

Check out on Amazon

6. Logitech StreamCam Premium Webcam – Ideal for streaming

The Logitech StreamCam is a premium-quality webcam that is designed for live streaming and recording videos. It features a premium glass lens that captures vibrant, true-to-life image quality with crisp details. It also has intelligent auto-focus and AI auto-framing that keeps you in frame without losing focus, even when you’re moving in front of the camera.

There are also a number of other features that make the StreamCam a great choice for streamers. You can fit more into the frame with its 78-degree FOV. Besides that, It also features an intelligent exposure system that automatically adjusts the aperture and ISO speed of the camera in real-time to ensure accurate skin tones for a more natural, healthy look, even in varying lighting conditions.

The StreamCam works seamlessly with popular live streaming software such as Open Broadcaster Software (OBS), XSplit, and Streamlabs OBS. You can stream your videos to Twitch, YouTube, and other streaming platforms. It also has a versatile mounting option that lets you mount it directly on your monitor or tripod.

Overall, the Logitech StreamCam is an excellent webcam for streamers and video creators. It has a number of features that allow you to create high-quality content. If you’re looking for a webcam that can help you take your streaming to the next level, then the Logitech StreamCam is a great option.

Pros

  • Features a USB-C connector
  • Offers several useful AI features

Cons

  • Only records at 1080p 60fps
  • Expensive for a 1080p webcam

Check out on Amazon

7. Anker PowerConf C302 – Built-in noise cancellation

The Anker PowerConf C302 Smart Webcam is a high-quality webcam that is perfect for video conferencing. It has a number of features that make it ideal for business professionals, including AI Framing, AI Color Adjustment, AI Exposure, and Clip, Plug, and Play functionality.

The AI Framing feature keeps you in the center of the frame, even if you’re moving around. In presentations, this ensures that your audience is always focused on you. AI Color Adjustment and AI Exposure ensure that no matter what the lighting conditions, you always look your best.

The C302 also has a number of other features that make it ideal for video conferencing, including a 2K/30fps camera, high fidelity dual microphones, AI-powered low-lighting correction, and a revolutionary AI technology that adapts the field of view based on the number of people in your meeting.

Pros

  • Features a USB-C connector
  • Highly adjustable mounting system

Cons

  • Limited field of view
  • Only supports up to 2K resolution at 30fps

Check out on Amazon

8. Creative Live! Cam Sync 4K UHD – Plug and play on Mac

For those who demand the best in video and audio quality without going over budget, the Creative Live! Cam Sync 4K is the perfect webcam. This powerful webcam provides exceptional 4K UHD resolution and stunning visual clarity, ensuring you look your best on video calls and live streams.

Equipped with an 8MP Sony IMX sensor and built-in dual microphones, the Creative Live! Cam Sync 4K Webcam excels at capturing every detail with remarkable sharpness and crystal-clear audio. Meanwhile, the advanced backlight compensation feature helps ensure you’ll always appear well-lit and professional, even in dimly lit environments.

The Creative Live! Cam Sync 4K Webcam also offers exceptional versatility with its 95° wide-angle lens that features an adjustable focus ring and a mount that supports 360° horizontal rotation and 30° tilt. This allows you to frame your shots perfectly, whether you’re in a meeting or catching up with friends and family. For added privacy, the webcam also has a lens cap.

Pros

  • Uses an 8 MP Sony IMX sensor
  • Cost-effective for a 4K webcam

Cons

  • Lacks AI auto-framing
  • Questionable build quality

Check out on Amazon

9. OBSBOT Meet AI-Powered 4K Webcam – Low light correction

This high-end webcam uses Sony’s 1/2.8 CMOS sensor to capture videos at 4K 30fps or 1080p 60fps. You can easily eliminate distracting backdrops or add a virtual backdrop to make your video calls look professional with one-click background blur. You can also adjust the light on the webcam for HDR auto-correction.

ONSBOT Meet also supports AI auto-framing that automatically pans and zooms the camera to always keep you in the center of the frame. What’s great about this feature is that it’s even capable of tracking multiple faces at once, making the webcam perfect for group meetings.

Apart from these features, the OBSBOT Meet 4K webcam comes with a reinforced foldable magnetic mount, providing many stable and convenient placement options. It also comes with a dedicated OBSBOT WebCam App, which allows you to adjust AI features, preview videos, capture videos, and access other advanced features.

Pros

  • Uses a 1/2.8 Sony CMOS sensor
  • Supports group auto-framing

Cons

  • Questionable mounting system

Check out on Amazon

Wrapping up…

As we spend more time indoors, our webcams are portals to staying connected with others and the world. So, it’s wise to invest in the best Mac webcam for your needs.

I hope this guide helped you make an informed decision. If you still have questions, let me know in the comments below.

acceptedAnswer.text: To remove an Apple Watch band, first place the watch face down on a soft surface. Press and hold the band release button on the back of the watch. Slide the band sideways out of its slot.

acceptedAnswer.text: Rubber, silicone, or sports bands are the easiest to clean because they are water-resistant, durable, and can be quickly washed with soap and water.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are a number of ways to insure your iPhone. However, most people prefer buying directly from AppleCare.

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

title.rendered: Best iPhone data recovery software for Mac and Windows in 2026

content.rendered:
Let’s face it: we all keep our most sensitive and crucial data on our iPhones. Once I lost all my saved data in a split second accidentally. It became worse when I could not restore it from backup. In this situation, an iPhone data recovery software helped me to tackle data loss. 

These software, at least some of them, help you fix your iPhone, while others retrieve deleted data. I have tried, tried, and reviewed many paid and free iPhone data recovery software for Mac and Windows and compiled a list of the best ones. 

Table of Contents
  • Things to consider when choosing iPhone data recovery software
  • 1. Tenorshare UltData – Editor's choice
  • 2. Dr.Fone by Wondershare – For extensive recovery
  • 3. iBeeSoft iPhone data recovery – Best value for money
  • 4. TunesKit – Selective iOS data recovery
  • 5. iMobie PhoneRescue – Repair and recover iOS
  • 6. Stellar Data Recovery for iPhone – Privacy-centric software
  • 7. EaseUs Mobisaver – One time payments
  • 8. FoneLab – Quickest data recovery software

Before that, let’s know what things you should check before purchasing iOS data recovery software.

Things to consider when choosing iPhone data recovery software

You may find hundreds of iPhone data recovery software. But most may not work for you. So, keep the following factors in mind before you stick to one:  

  • Ensure that the software is trustworthy and does not gather any private information, 
  • It should have an intuitive and user-friendly interface.
  • Verify compatibility with your Mac, macOS, iPhone, and iOS. 
  • It should offer good technical support. 
  • Supports a variety of data formats and recovery sources. 
  • Do check reviews.

I have taken all the criteria while choosing these, so let’s jump in!

Table of Contents
  1. Tenorshare UltData – Editor's choice
  2. Dr.Fone by Wondershare – For extensive recovery
  3. iBeeSoft iPhone data recovery – Best value for money
  4. TunesKit – Selective iOS data recovery
  5. iMobie PhoneRescue – Repair and recover iOS
  6. Stellar Data Recovery for iPhone – Privacy-centric software
  7. EaseUs Mobisaver – One time payments
  8. FoneLab – Quickest data recovery software

1. Tenorshare UltData – Editor’s choice

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15
  • Requirements: macOS 10.8+
  • iOS system repair capabilities.
  • Data recovery directly from backups and iTunes.
  • 35 file types are supported.

Tenorshare has received the highest user ratings for iOS data recovery software as it recovers data more quickly than others. Whatever the situation, including shattered screen, locked or frozen phone, system failure, virus attacks, etc., Tenoshare got you covered. It takes only a few minutes to complete the recovery process.

If you have system root done, you can still retrieve your data loss from iCloud, iTunes, and iOS device backup. I loved the feature of selective data recovery, to retrieve only particular files. It supports 35+ file formats, including voicemail, messages, app data, chat attachments, etc., and has several recovery procedures. 

To help you make a purchasing decision, we have made a whole Tenoshare review.

Pros

  • Supports rooted systems
  • Retrieve large files
  • Great preview feature  

Cons

  • Comparatively expensive 

Price: Free to download and preview (Licence starts for $69.95/year)

Download

2. Dr.Fone by Wondershare – For extensive recovery

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15 
  • Requirements: macOS 10.8+
  • Supports system repair, screen-unlock, iOS to Android phone transfer, and virtual location features.
  • Recovers notes, attachments, voicemails, call history, reminders, and other file types. 
  • Transfer, store, and retrieve data from social apps like Facebook and WhatsApp

Like other Wondershare software, Dr.Fone is a dependable and easy-to-use tool. The program restores deleted data from any iOS device, including iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch. It uses a well-known, three-step data recovery technique to preview and restore the selected files. 

You can get back your data, whether it’s accidental deletion, system crash, device damage, stolen device, or ROM flashing. The software retrieves data such as call history, messages, and calendars to all multimedia files from local iPhone storage, iTunes backup files, and iCloud.

The free version only shows previews of data loss and doesn’t allow for saving retrieved files.  I tried it on macOS 12, iOS 15, and Windows 11 devices and loved its simplicity and ease of use. I loved its simplicity and easy-to-use features.

Pros

  • Convenient to use
  • Reliable 3-step data recovery process
  • Large previews 

Cons

  • Can’t save recovered data in the free version
  • Not fully recovers all data

Price: Free to download and preview (Licence starts for $69.95/year)

Download

3. iBeeSoft iPhone data recovery – Best value for money 

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15 
  • Requirements: macOS 10.14 and older
  • Modern data recovery technology for iPhone data recovery without backup. 
  • Supports over 20 file formats. 
  • Deep scanning feature.

Have you forgotten to create a backup for your iPhone and now accidentally lost all your data? You can still bring your lost data back using iBeeSoft iOS data recovery software. It comes with fundamental data recovery techniques without any complex fancy features. Hence, super easy to use!

You can get back lost or deleted data from your iPhone if there’s a factory reset, stolen, lost, system crash, or something else. It supports all common file types like images, videos, contacts, call history, notes and reminders, voice memos, Safari history, and more, and extracts from iTunes and iCloud backup.

Go through our detailed iBeeSoft for Mac review to get a clearer idea of its features.

Pros

  • Simple and user-friendly interface
  • 3 recovery modes for 1 price
  • 24/7 technical support

Cons

  • Support up to iPhone 12 and macOS 10.14
  • Can’t resolve iOS system errors

Price: Free for preview (Licence starts for $39.95/year)

Download

4. TunesKit – Selective iOS data recovery

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15 
  • Requirements: macOS 10.8+
  • Recover over 20 types of lost and deleted data.
  • Lifetime free upgrade.
  • 24/7 technical support.

TunesKit iPhone data recovery software for Mac saves you from any iOS data disaster by thoroughly and swiftly recovering over 20 types of data from iTunes and iCloud backups. Its smart recovery modes can tackle accidental deletion, device loss, jailbreak failure, system crash, iOS upgrade/downgrade error, wrong password lock, etc.

You can effortlessly recover all deleted or lost data with three easy clicks. First, connect the device to Mac and then scan for the lost data. The selective recovery feature displays all data clearly in one location to pick certain retrieved files to save. It makes the recovery process more precise and versatile. 

TunesKit especially focuses on data privacy. Your account is only accessible to you. Also, stay relaxed about existing data because it doesn’t overwrite the restored files.

Pros

  • Smart recovery mode
  • Advanced data privacy
  • Selective recovery feature 

Cons

  • Basic features only
  • The download process is a bit tricky

Price: Free to download (Licence starts for $39.95/year)

Download

5. iMobie PhoneRescue – Repair and recover iOS

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15 
  • Requirements: macOS 10.8+
  • Remove iPhone lock screen.
  • Screen time password recovery.
  • Save iPhone/iPad from Breakdowns.
  • Encrypted iTunes backup files recovery.

Besides attempting data recovery, PhoneRescue also resolves iOS system problems. You can repair frozen iPhones, iOS devices in Recovery or DFU Mode, and White, Blue, or Black screen of death. If you accidentally forget the Lock Screen or Screen Time Passcode, it can erase them. 

With only three clicks, you may restore 31 types of lost data, even from damaged backups. It uses several cutting-edge technologies such as NO-DATA-LOSS, ForceRestore, Thunder-Extraction, SmartCompare, etc. Hence, you receive secure, thorough, simple, and quick data recovery with a straightforward interface.

This iPhone data recovery software for Mac gave me complete access to my iOS devices. On my iPhone 13 Pro Max, it analyzed data in an hour. So, the recovery speed is quite lengthy compared to others. But the results were excellent except for video recovery. Before recovery, it offered deleted files as thumbnails (download option only for the paid version). 

I have comprehended all my experience in the iMobie PhoneRescue review. Read here!

Pros

  • Modern and easy-to-navigate interface
  • Fix iOS system issues
  • Device Rescue feature 
  • 60 days money-back guarantee

Cons

  • Slow recovery speed
  • Glitches in video recovery
  • Only good for getting accidentally deleted data 

Price: Free for preview (Licence starts for $69.99/year)

Download

6. Stellar Data Recovery for iPhone – Privacy-centric software

Features: 

  • Compatibility: iOS 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, and below 
  • Requirements: macOS Ventura, Monterey, Big Sur, or earlier 
  • Retrieve erased data from an encrypted backup. 
  • ‘Deep Scan’ for up to 100% data recovery. 
  • Delete third-party apps data and iPhone data permanently. 

Losing iPhone data is a common issue. Sometimes it arises because of a virus attack, while other time it happens because of our clumsiness. However, with Stellar data recovery software for iPhone, you do not have to worry about losing your important data ever. Be it the data from iCloud or iTunes- Stellar’s data recovery data saves it all.  

The software recovers lost or deleted photos, videos, audios, contacts, call history, Notes, encrypted data, etc. from iPod Touch /iPhone/iPad/iTunes and iCloud backup. All these features are accessible with the basic Standard edition. Though, you can choose the Toolkit edition for additional features like iOS system repair, iPhone data eraser, and removal of configured Apple ID. 

One of the best features of Stellar data recovery software for iPhone is the data deletion facility. It lets you delete any unnecessary third-party apps data from your core iOS system data with ease. Also, the data erasing feature permanently deletes iPhone data. Hence, no other data recovery software for iPhone can retrieve it, assuring your data is secure and confidential.  

Pros

  • Affordable
  • Fast recovery speed
  • Advanced scanning feature
  • Import data from PC to iPhone

Cons

  • Need to renew the license every year

Price: Free for preview (Licence starts for $39.99/year)

Download

7. EaseUs Mobisaver – One time payments

Features:

  • Compatibility: iPhone 13 and older
  • Requirements: macOS 10.14 and older
  • Sort scanning results by file type.
  • Retrieve a missing partition.
  • Recover over 1000 different data types.
  • Technician license for the businesses.

If you want to avoid paying a regular membership charge, EaseUS MobiSaver, with free lifetime updates, is for you. That means you need to pay just once to handle any data loss. With 18 years of experience, EaseUS offers the perfect iPhone data recovery software for Mac named MobiSaver.

In the free edition, it allows for only one picture or video recovery and five contacts from your iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch. With the Pro Edition, you can restore unlimited iOS data, including texts, Kik messages, and WhatsApp history. Besides, it provides data recovery from non-responsive and malfunctioning devices.

If you are an IT provider and need to fix multiple iOS devices, you can opt for the Technician edition. I had a faced problem using it as I had macOS 12, and it doesn’t support that. Also, it was unable to store a few retrieved files.

Pros

  • Recover one photo & video in the free version
  • Free lifetime upgrades and technical support
  • Automatic Recovery feature
  • Secure with 256-bit SSL

Cons

  • Pricey
  • Doesn’t support the latest version of macOS
  • Recovery glitches

Price: Free (Licence starts for $79.95/year)

Download

8. FoneLab – Quickest data recovery software

Features:

  • Compatibility: up to iOS 15 
  • Requirements: macOS 10.7+
  • View in-depth details on your missing data.
  • A broad range of third-party app recovery support.
  • Capable of recovering 19 different kinds of data.
  • Recover images from third-party apps like Instagram.

Aiseesoft Fonelab is the ideal for recovering data as soon as possible with its quick scanning performance and data recovery speed. It can access over 19 different data types from your iCloud, iTunes backups, and iOS devices. But the iCloud backup should not have two-factor authentication enabled.

Fonelab features a user-friendly design and big preview icons. With its high success rate, it completes the task at hand. The only problem I had with FoneLab was that it categorized some of my photos differently. Later I found them in the Camera Roll. 

Pros

  • Scan and preview existing data
  • Protects private information
  • High success rate

Cons

  • Doesn’t support various data types

Price: Free for preview (Licence starts for $69.95/year)

Download

So, that’s all, folks!

Always try to create a backup for your iPhone so that the iOS data recovery will be easier. Before purchasing a license for an iPhone data recovery software, check their preview. Thus, you will know what files you may get back. Which one seemed the most reliable software for Mac to you? Let me know in the comments below.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. title.rendered: Best iPhone SE 2 Card Holder Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
There are countless cases for your iPhone SE 2, but if you’re looking for something versatile, a cardholder case might be just what you need. These offer the convenience of keeping your essential credit/debit or identity cards close at hand. At the same time, they keep your phone looking sleek. Here’s a roundup of some of the best iPhone SE 2 card holder cases.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Smartish Case with Card Holder
  • 2. Spigen Card Holder Case
  • 3. OT ONETOP Leather Case with Card Holder
  • 4. TORU Case with Hidden Card Holding Compartment
  • 5. Dockem Synthetic Leather Card Holder Case
  • 6. Vena iPhone SE 2 Folio Cover with Card Holder
  • 7. KIHUWEY Card Holder Leather Case
  • 8. ANHONG Clear Case with Card Holder
  • 9. LAMEEKU Card Holder Case with Zip Pouch

1. Smartish Case with Card Holder

This versatile case from Smartish is perfect for easy access to your essential cards and some cash. It can fit up to three cards, and it stays ultra-light and slim.

As for protecting your device, the textured sides offer excellent grip, and the protective air pocket corners can keep dents away. You can get it in black or blue colors, a floral pattern, or a custom design of your choice.

Pros

  • Ultra-light yet durable
  • High-grip textured sides
  • Custom design option

Cons

  • Not shockproof

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen Card Holder Case

Keep your cards discreetly concealed in this slim dual layer card slot holder. It holds two cards while also protecting your iPhone with air-cushion technology and a shockproof exterior.

Moreover, it has a unique slim look that won’t add any extra bulk to your phone. You can choose from four color options, namely red, rose-gold, black, and gunmetal.

Pros

  • Dual layers & air cushion technology
  • A slim armor case
  • Color options

Cons

  • Difficult to open and close the card slot

Check out on Amazon

3. OT ONETOP Leather Case with Card Holder

This leather case for your iPhone SE 2 has plenty of space for your essentials with three card slots and a cash pocket. It’s made of premium quality PU leather that is durable and feels comfortable to hold.

Further, it can be converted into a multi-angle comfortable view for reading, watching videos, or FaceTime. Precise cutouts for buttons and ports ensure ease of use.

Pros

  • Practical design
  • Kickstand functionality
  • Color options

Cons

  • Magnetic closure may weaken over time

Check out on Amazon

4. TORU Case with Hidden Card Holding Compartment

This dual-layer case is made of soft rubber TPU & hard plastic to protect against shocks and drops. Further, the raised bezels safeguard the screen against scratches.

It holds up to two cards and comes with a plastic adhesive mirror that can be stuck into the rear compartment if you want. Available in a few different shades, including black, navy blue, rose gold, and a marble pattern.

Pros

  • Raised bezels
  • Practical design
  • Kickstand functionality

Cons

  • No bright colors

Check out on Amazon

5. Dockem Synthetic Leather Card Holder Case

This cardholder case stands out for its classy and minimalist look. It has two card slots and is compatible with wireless charging, making it a practical way to protect your second-generation iPhone SE. However, you’ll need to remove your cards from the case before using wireless charging.

Even with cards inserted, it’s less than 14 mm thick, which ensures a sleek look. Further, the twill style texture offers a comfortable grip for ease of use. Precise cutouts further enhance the functionality of this case.

Pros

  • Wireless charging compatibility
  • Slim and lightweight (0.55 inches with cards)
  • Good grip

Cons

  • No raised edges for screen protection
  • Limited color options

Check out on Amazon

6. Vena iPhone SE 2 Folio Cover with Card Holder

This folio case boasts a unique, patented design that combines functionality and protection. There’s a hidden card slot, and the foldable leather flap on it doubles up as a kickstand.

Further, the dual-layer design meets military drop-test standards. It can survive up to 26 drops from 4 feet high, and CornerGuard technology fortifies all four corners of the case.

Pros

  • Military-grade protection
  • Unique look
  • Hidden card slot

Cons

  • Limited color options

Check out on Amazon

7. KIHUWEY Card Holder Leather Case

This high-quality PU leather case has five card slots. One is on the exterior, while a magnetic flap closure conceals four. This flap can also be used as a kickstand for convenience whenever needed.

Further, the raised edges help prevent scratches from surfaces. You can get this case in five colors, black, brown, blue, red, and rose gold.

Pros

  • Five card-slots
  • Kickstand functionality
  • Raised bezels

Cons

  • Not much drop protection

Check out on Amazon

8. ANHONG Clear Case with Card Holder

This ultra-thin clear case for your iPhone SE 2 adds minimal bulk and has a slot for your most essential card. Raised lips help avoid scratches and direct impact, while built-in air pockets cushion the corners.

Further, the micro-dot design prevents the TPU from sticking to the back of your phone. It comes with a 12-month warranty and a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

Pros

  • Micro-dot design
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Raised edges

Cons

  • Not much drop protection

Check out on Amazon

9. LAMEEKU Card Holder Case with Zip Pouch

If you want a one-stop solution to carry plenty of essentials, this case offers two cash pockets and four card slots. That’s much more than other similar options, but of course, it adds to the bulk.

The soft leather and TPU provide sturdy protection from drops while the raised edges keep the screen raised when placed on flat surfaces. Moreover, it’s beautifully hand-crafted and comes with a limited lifetime warranty for ultimate customer satisfaction.

Pros

  • Durable
  • Spacious
  • Warranty
  • Four color options

Cons

  • Bulky

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up!

Convenient, practical, stylish, and of course, protective – cardholder cases are an ideal choice for your iPhone SE 2. Which case did you like the most? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best USB-C to Ethernet Adapters for MacBook in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple seems to be on a never-ending quest to go completely port-less. It started in 2014 when the tech giant decided to remove the ethernet port from its MacBook devices. Mac undoubtedly looks neater, but we can’t deny that wired internet is much faster than wireless. Considering this, I thought of sharing some of the best USB-C to ethernet adapters for MacBook available on the web.

But before moving on to those, here’s the list of MacBooks that you can use USB-C to ethernet adapters with;

  • MacBook Pro 13-inch (2016 or later)
  • MacBook Pro 15-inch (2016 or later)
  • MacBook Pro 16-inch
  • MacBook Air 13-inch (2018 or later)
  • MacBook 12-inch (2015-2017)
Table of Contents
  • Best USB-C to Eth­er­net Adapters for MacBook Pro and Air
    • 1. Belkin USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter
    • 2. Anker USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter
    • 3. Bauihr USB 3.0 Hub Ethernet with USB-C Adapter
    • 4. UGREEN
    • 5. MCY 8-in-1 Type-C Hub Adapter
    • 6. JSAUX
    • 7. MOKiN USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet USB A 3.0 Adapter Hub
    • 8. Belkin USB-C to Ethernet Adapter + Charge
    • 9. uni Store
    • 10. TP-Link
    • 11. uni USB-C Hub with RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet
    • 12. JYZZ
  • Which USB-C to ethernet adapter are you buying?

Best USB-C to Eth­er­net Adapters for MacBook Pro and Air

1. Belkin USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter

Belkin is a trusted brand when it’s about consumer electronics and connected devices. Perhaps that’s what gives it a space on Apple’s official online store. The USB-C to gigabit ethernet adapter features a compact design and sophisticated looks. It mates seamlessly with MacBook with USB-C or Pro with Thunderbolt 3 (USB-C) ports and supports 10/100/1000BASE-T for flawless connectivity.

The cable length measures 6 inches, giving you sufficient space to place it securely on your work desk when connected with your device and ethernet cable.

Check out on Apple

2. Anker USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter

The second in our list is another known brand with over 50 million users. The adapter can deliver you speed up to 10/100/1000Mbps with the utmost ease. It measures 2.2 inches in length and 1 inch in width and weighs 1.1 oz, making it ultra-compact and easy to carry in your pocket. Lastly, to keep you updated about connectivity, it comes with three LED indicators. The Red shows it’s powered on; Green indicates the ethernet cable is connected, and the flashing Blue light reflects the internet connectivity.

Check out on Amazon

3. Bauihr USB 3.0 Hub Ethernet with USB-C Adapter

Talk about blending tech with creativity, and you can’t skip mentioning Bauihr USB 3.0 Hub Ethernet with USB-C Adapter. The affordable ethernet adapter is also home to three USB sockets to connect Mouse, Hard disk, Printer, USB storage devices, etc. Besides, it offers dual connectivity with a USB cable. The same can be transformed into Type A in a blink of an eye. It also offers you a network speed of up to 1000Mbps and a transfer speed of up to 5Gbps effortlessly.

Check out on Amazon

4. UGREEN

It stays true to its brand identity. The adapter is housed with an RTL8153B chip to deliver robust and uninterrupted connectivity. The network LAN converter can offer a speed of up to 10/100/1000Mbps and is genuinely an inexpensive option for your MacBook’s traditional RJ45 port. The design aesthetics are stylish and durable with the aluminum case. Additionally, it is also fingerprint and corrosion-resistant.

Check out on Amazon

5. MCY 8-in-1 Type-C Hub Adapter

The 8-in-1 adapter comes with three USB 3.0 connectors, 1 4K HDMI port, one ethernet port, 1 100W PD USB-C port, one SD, and 1 TF card slot. It can offer maximum HDMI output to 3840*2160@30Hz resolution. The adapter may seem a little bulky, but that’s due to multiple outputs. Perhaps, this is what makes it a little pricey compared to others on the list. If you are looking for something that serves several purposes, this should be a perfect buy.

Check out on Amazon

6. JSAUX

The stylish USB-C to ethernet adapter can offer up to 1000Mbps speed if you have a CAT6 or above ethernet cables. While the design holds your attention, it is made using durable wire and aluminum alloy shell that makes it a preferred choice. The connecting wire can withstand over 15000 bends. There are two LED indicators at the ethernet port’s face that tell you the connectivity status.

Check out on Amazon

7. MOKiN USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet USB A 3.0 Adapter Hub

Adding to the list is another multi-port USB-C to ethernet adapter. It is available in space gray and silver color options and can offer you stable internet connectivity of up to 1Gbps. The 4-in-1 USB-C adapter lets you access the internet, transfer data at up to 5Gbps speed, and data transfer using USB-A. The adapter measures 90mm in length and 23.5mm in width, making it super compact and easy to carry.

Check out on Amazon

8. Belkin USB-C to Ethernet Adapter + Charge

Another one from the leading connected device maker. What makes it pricey compared to the preceding adapter is its ability to let you charge while you are connected to the internet. And let me mention, the charging power is up to 60W, which is sufficient to power charge your device. The inclusion eventually impacts the dimensions, which doesn’t make it a complete pocket-friendly accessory. However, carrying it in your laptop bag would be super easy. Besides this, everything is similar to its budget sibling.

Check out on Amazon

9. uni Store

This one’s an invincible amalgamation of technology with durability. It is made using a durable aluminum case and can offer up to 16Gbps stable connectivity effortlessly. The compact and lightweight design makes it worth a buy. The wire length is sufficient to place it securely on your work desk and carry it anywhere.

Check out on Amazon

10. TP-Link

TP-Link is no new name in the internet connectivity devices. Hence, there’s no space for any doubt about the quality of this USB-C to ethernet adapter. It comes with a USB-C 3.0 and gigabit ethernet port that offers you seamless connectivity and maximum speed effortlessly. It is designed to elevate your surfing experience, online game, HD streaming, and video chats. Besides, it comes in a sleek and foldable design that makes it physically pocket-friendly.

Check out on Amazon

11. uni USB-C Hub with RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet

Thanks to the elegant design and remarkable performance, uni reappeared in our list for the day. What differentiates this from the preceding model is its additional three USB 3.0 ports to connect your peripherals. It is designed using durable materials to equip you with the best experience. Finally, you can plug and play without the need for any additional software to access this.

Check out on Amazon

12. JYZZ

The last in the list is the most affordable and low-priced USB-C to ethernet adapter by JYZZ. However, it doesn’t compromise with the quality and offerings. It offers you a wired speed of up to 1 Gbps. It also has two LED indicators showing the connectivity of ethernet cable and internet. The seller is currently offering 30 days money-back guarantee and a six-month free replacement warranty if you receive a defective piece.

Check out on Amazon

Which USB-C to ethernet adapter are you buying?

I own Belkin’s adapter with a charging port, and it’s working great, but I am soon switching to a multi-port ethernet adapter. My pick from the list would be Bauihr USB 3.0 Hub Ethernet with USB-C Adapter or MCY 8-in-1 Type-C Hub Adapter.

What’s your view on this? Which one you liked the most or have plans to buy? Don’t forget to share your thoughts in the comment section.

  • Best USB-C to HDMI cables for Mac
  • Photo Editing Apps for Mac
  • How to Use Ethernet on iPad Pro?

title.rendered: Best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
We, weebs and Otakus, always look for convenient and immersive platforms to devour our favorite manga. However, with many options available, it might get confusing to find a platform where you can read non-pirated manga. That’s why I have brought you the best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad. With these apps, you will never miss a new chapter and will have an exceptional reading experience!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Shonen Jump Manga & Comics – Editor's choice
  • 2. MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA – Best app to read manga for free
    • 3. VIZ Manga – All genres in one place
    • 4. WebComics – Enjoy webtoons with manga
    • 5. MangaToon – Read manga in your language
    • 6. Manga Readеr – Offline reading companion
    • 8. Manga Storm CBR – Read different manga formats

1. Shonen Jump Manga & Comics – Editor’s choice

Shonen Jump is the most-used app on my iPhone. It provides all the trending shonen manga and lets you download chapters to read offline. I love to read the ongoing series on it as the app updates new chapters whenever it’s available in Japan. That takes the waiting game out of the picture.

You will enjoy each manga panel as the app offers a 2-page spread view in landscape mode. Besides, it syncs your reading progress across all your devices to help you keep track of your favorite series. The best part is you can get a free preview of premium volumes before purchase.  

Titles available: My Hero Academia, Jujutsu Kaisen, One Piece, Chainsaw Man, Demon Slayer, One-Punch Man, Naruto, Bleach, Death Note, Dragon Ball, Boruto, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Spy x Family, etc.

Pros

  • 15,000+ manga chapters
  • No ads
  • Dark mode available

Cons

  • Difficult to switch between landscape and portrait modes
  • The interface could be improved 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

2. MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA – Best app to read manga for free

Any list of free manga reading apps would be incomplete without this top pick – MANGA Plus. This is the official manga reader from Shueisha Inc., the publisher behind the most notable comics such as Naruto, Dragon Ball, One Piece, Bleach, and more. My current favorite is Spy X Family.

It’s available globally, and you get the latest chapters for free simultaneously when they are released in Japan. Moreover, the app directly compensates the creators and avoids piracy. My favorite part about this app is connecting with a large web community and leaving comments on each chapter you read.

You can even create a collection of your favorite manga. Lastly, the app is well laid out and easy to navigate. Rotating your phone quickly switches between landscape and portrait modes. You can even choose the reading direction and manga resolution.

Titles available: One Piece, My Hero Academia, Jujutsu Kaisen, Hunter x Hunter, Black Clover, Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, Dragon Ball Super, Bleach, Naruto, Death Note, Tokyo Ghoul, Mashle: magic and Muscles, etc.

Pros

  • Classic legendary manga collection
  • Read for free
  • Multiple language translation

Cons

  • Some chapter gaps
  • Limited content

Price: Free

Download

3. VIZ Manga – All genres in one place

VIZ Manga offers the most comprehensive collection of manga of all genres, including shojo romance, slice of life, drama, comedy, horror, etc. I use this app to read new chapters of Komi Can’t Communicate for free (no pun intended ). The app updates its library weekly and makes the chapters available the same day it is released in Japan.  

The manga reader is easy to use and displays each panel as original without cropping. Moreover, you may read offline by downloading chapters. Also, the registered users can continue reading where they left off and sync all devices. Moreover, the premium subscription is affordable and gives access to the whole library. 

Titles available: Komi Can’t Communicate, Uzumaki, Inuyasha, Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead, Nana, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, Kimi ni Todoke, Call of the Night, etc.

Pros

  • 10,000+ manga chapters
  • Create a personal reading list
  • Few titles offer new chapters for free

Cons

  • Glitchy sometimes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download

4. WebComics – Enjoy webtoons with manga

Not only manga but also webtoons take up a large portion of my reading list. And WebComics is the best place to get trending webtoons. It has an extensive collection of manga, comics, manhwa, anime, etc. In almost all genres! Also, it includes American, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese comic books.

Besides, BL lovers can enjoy exclusive original series. I liked its simple UI, smooth reading experience, full-colored HD panels, and personalized suggestions. The app releases new comics and updates chapters daily. Further, you may unlock exclusive deals to read limited-edition books.  

The best part is you can interact with your favorite creator via the creator community. The app also has connected 8000k comic enthusiasts worldwide. Additionally, you may create your own community and chat with web friends.

Titles available: My Disciples Are She-Devils, The God Devourer, Marvelous Hero of the Sword, Bride of the Dawn, The Naive Mr. Lu, School Beauty’s Private Bodyguard, etc.

Pros

  • Free manga released every day
  • Exclusive original content
  • Supports full-screen view and dark mode
  • Interactive creator community

Cons

  • Need to buy coins to read for free
  • No way to track read and unread comics. 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

5. MangaToon – Read manga in your language

If you want an app to read more than manga, then MangaToon is ideal. It offers various manhua, comic books, novels, and chat stories. To enjoy premium chapters for free, you may earn free points and reading vouchers. The best part is the app supports 8 more languages besides English. 

Titles available: Mademoiselle will mess around, Bossy President, Dragon Princess Yuan, The Heiress Young Ruffian, etc.

Pros

  • Publish your original stories in their community
  • Multiple language translations
  • Read novels and chat stories
  • iMessage support

Cons

  • The library is updated weekly
  • Reading on iPad is glitchy

Price: Free ($0.99 for 100 coins)

Download

6. Manga Readеr – Offline reading companion

While on the go, we don’t have a stable network connection to fetch and load HD manga. To solve this, I suggest using the Manga Reader app. It offers 1000+ manga titles to pick and download for offline reading. Hence, you will get the finest uninterrupted reading experience.

Besides, I liked its smooth navigation and personalized daily recommendations on the “Today” home page. Moreover, the app has enhanced filtering and search capabilities to explore new titles quickly. However, the app requires a membership to read a whole manga.

Titles available: Solo Leveling, Jujutsu Kaisen, Black Clover, Hunter X Hunter, Chainsaw Man, One-Punch Man, Naruto, etc.

Pros

  • Personalized manga recommendations
  • Minimal and non-intrusive advertisements
  • Multiple reading modes

Cons

  • Needs a subscription to read manga

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

8. Manga Storm CBR – Read different manga formats

This app is a free manga comic reader that can fetch DRM-free comics in CBR/CBZ/PDF files from your cloud storage. So, it imports comics you already have on the cloud onto your iPhone or iPad for easy offline reading. Also, you can use it to organize your imported comics in multilevel folders (called “comic groups”).

Besides, the app lets you set your most comfortable reading direction. Further, your reading progress is saved automatically, and you can even read multiple comics continuously, moving from the last page of the current one to the first page of the next comic with a swipe.

Of course, this app does not help discover any new content. It’s solely a manga reader app for those who already have comics in supported formats like CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, RAR, ZIP, 7Z, TAR, and PDF files.

Pros

  • Handy reading options 
  • Supports multiple file formats
  • Create Comic driver
  • Automatic bookmarking

Cons

  • The interface looks outdated and clunky

Price: Free (Get Pro subscription at $2.99)

Download

Enjoy fellow otakus, Dattebayo!

The best manga reader apps for iPhone and iPad offer a convenient and immersive way to indulge in the captivating world of manga. With various features, extensive libraries, offline reading, and user-friendly interfaces, these apps cater to the preferences of all manga enthusiasts.

Which app do you use to read manga and comics? Let me know in the comments below; I will surely try that app!

mainEntity.name: Can you insure an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are a number of ways to insure your iPhone. However, most people prefer buying directly from AppleCare.

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

title.rendered: Best hidden iPhone secret codes to know in 2026

content.rendered:
All smartphones, including iPhones, can reveal information or perform some handy action when entering a specific USSD code. Since these secret dialer codes are not mentioned explicitly, you may not be aware of them. To assist, I have listed 15 useful iPhone secret codes that you will find interesting and helpful. Take a look.

Table of Contents
  • What are iPhone secret codes?
  • 15 most useful iPhone secret codes
    • 1. Find out how much signal your iPhone has
    • 2. Hide or show your caller ID
    • 3. Check the SMS center
    • 4. Check, enable, or disable Call Waiting status
    • 5. See iPhone IMEI number
    • 6. See iPhone IMSI
    • 7. Check Call barring
    • 8. Forward calls
    • 9. Get local traffic information
    • 10. Check cellular data usage
    • 11. Check Call Line Presentation
    • 12. Check the postpaid or prepaid account balance
    • 13. Check alert system
    • 14. See your missed calls
    • 15. Full Rate Mode

What are iPhone secret codes?

Secret codes are just a fancy name for Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), which are strings of characters basically used by developers and technicians to troubleshoot smartphones. 

Every smartphone has a different set of access codes and shortcuts that allow you to modify internal iPhone settings.

If you’re a ’90s kid, these secret codes were more popular back when the device’s settings were less sophisticated and didn’t allow users to modify their functions. Regardless, these codes still let you do certain things faster and access information readily, with fewer taps. 

15 most useful iPhone secret codes

Before you begin:

  • Please note that several codes mentioned here may not work globally or with all carriers. They are functional only in the United States and their carriers.
  • To use all these codes, you have to open the Phone app and be in the Keypad tab. Some codes require you to tap the call button, while a few may not.

Now, let the magic begin!

1. Find out how much signal your iPhone has

To find out, you can Enter Field Test Mode by typing *3001#12345#*

This lets you see all the details about your iPhone’s settings, network, and other technical data about your device.

You can use this to check your signal if you have poor reception. Just look for Rsrp, which stands for Reference Signal Received Power. Rsrp0 is the tower nearest you, while Rsrp1 is the second closest. Beside it are numbers ranging from -40 to -140 decibel-milliwatts. Signals closer to -40 indicate a strong signal, while a number closer to -140 indicates that you have a poor connection.

2. Hide or show your caller ID

If your carrier supports hiding your caller ID, you can use this secret code to hide your caller ID. This means that when you call someone, they’ll see an Unknown or No Caller ID.

  • If you’re in the US, enter *67 before the number you want to call.
  • If you’re outside the US, enter *31 before the number and hit the Call button.

On the other hand, add *82 before the number to show your Caller ID.

3. Check the SMS center

Whenever you send an SMS, it goes straight to the SMS center or server before being forwarded to the receiver. If you’re facing any issues with SMS, enter the hidden code *#5005*7672# on your iPhone to see more details.

4. Check, enable, or disable Call Waiting status

The Call Waiting feature notifies you of another call when you’re already on a call. To learn if this is enabled on your iPhone, use the code *#43#. Dialing *43# enables it, while using #43# disables it.

5. See iPhone IMEI number

The International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) is a 15 to 17-digit number that serves as a unique ID for your phone’s hardware. Carriers can block stolen or lost phones using their IMEI at a network level. This is important to know when your device gets stolen or lost.

Just type the code *#06# to see your IMEI and other details.

6. See iPhone IMSI

The international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) can be seen on your SIM card packet the moment you buy it. It is a unique number that identifies every user of a cellular network. Find your IMSI number by dialing 5005# on the keypad.

7. Check Call barring 

Call barring lets you block incoming or outgoing calls to and from your phone. This may be useful if you keep receiving unwanted telemarketer calls or want to avoid expensive international calls.

To check if the feature is enabled on your device, dial *#33#. Use the code *33*pin# to enable call barring on your iPhone. To disable call barring, dial #33*pin#.

8. Forward calls

Using the call forwarding feature, you can easily forward your calls to your phone’s answering machine or another number. Use the code *#21# to check for its status on your iPhone. 

Alternatively, you can directly dial *21#. This enables call forwarding if disabled and disables it if it’s currently enabled.

You can also elect to forward your calls to another number by adding *21 to the phone number to which you want to forward your calls.

Depending on your carrier, there are also varied ways to forward calls on your iPhone.

9. Get local traffic information

Sometimes you want to know the traffic status but aren’t connected to the internet to use traffic apps like Google Maps. In such cases, you may dial 511 to learn about your local traffic.

10. Check cellular data usage

If you’re on prepaid and rely on cellular data for your connection, you can easily check your cellular data usage by dialing the following codes below, depending on your carrier: 

  • AT&T: *3282#
  • Verizon: #3282
  • T-mobile: #932#

Meanwhile, if you’re on postpaid, you can check your data plan status by using the code *646#.

11. Check Call Line Presentation

Call Line Presentation enables the call recipient to see the telephone number of their caller. If the recipient of your call can’t see your number, you may want to check if Call Line Presentation is enabled on your phone by dialing *#30#.

12. Check the postpaid or prepaid account balance

  • If you’re on postpaid, you can check your bill balance by entering *225#
  • If you’re on prepaid, check your account balance by typing *777#

13. Check alert system

Test Emergency Alerts contain government test alerts from your local government. This is disabled by default.

If you’re running iOS 15.3 or earlier, tap *5005*25371# to enable your iPhone’s Alert System Status. To turn it off, just enter *5005*25370#.

Meanwhile, if your phone is running iOS 15.6 or later, just head to Settings → Notifications →  toggle Test Alerts on or off. You can also check out our guide on how to turn off government alerts.

14. See your missed calls

If you’re wondering how many missed calls you have, just dial #61#.

15. Full Rate Mode

While the iPhone has numerous audio settings that let you adjust audio quality, you can also enable your iPhone’s Enhanced Full Rate (EFR) mode to improve your call sound quality. Just type *3370# to enable it.

The downside is that your iPhone will likely spend more power during calls.

Wrapping up…

I hope you learned about a few new shortcodes. Which one from the list above seems most helpful to you? Let me know in the comments below. Second, if you know other similar codes, share them with me as well. We would love to mention that in this post.

Finally, here are some more helpful posts you will love to check out:

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

title.rendered: Best iPad Pro 10.5-inch Screen Protectors in 2026

content.rendered:
The first line of defense that I make sure to choose for my iPad even before completely interacting with it is—a high-quality screen guard. Knowing how badly a little scratch can harm the user experience, I make sure to go for a trusted shield. And this wise decision always keeps my tablet on the safer side in the case of accidental falls! Taking all the must-have qualities in mind, I have selected the best 10.5-inch iPad Pro screen Protectors that have been prepared to stand up to the task admirably.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Anker
  • 2. TANTEK
  • 3. Skinomi Tech
  • 4. iCarez
  • 5. OMOTON
  • 6. Halnziye
  • 7. Ztotop
  • 8. amFilm
  • 9. ESR
  • 10. iLLumiShield

1. Anker


Anker screen guard is an absolute beast. Constructed with the finest tempered glass, it is enormously strong and fully capable of knocking down even ugly scratch. It’s just 0.3mm thick and comes with oleophobic coating to prevent fingerprints and dust.

Since it’s bubble-free, you will not have a hard time while installing it on your device screen. The high definition clarity offers a delightful viewing experience. Being highly sensitive, it recognizes your every touch and tap.

USP: HD clarity
Check out on Amazon

2. TANTEK

This screen defender from TANTEK is a reliable bet. And what puts it ahead of the curve is the precise laser cutting. So, expect this screen guard to perfectly fit on the screen.

The high clarity coupled with 9H hardness makes it a complete package. Thus, you have a much-improved viewing experienced. Lastly, TANTEK offers it in a pack of three topped by a lifetime replacement warranty.

USP: Anti-scuffs and smudge
Check out on Amazon

3. Skinomi Tech

Skinomi Tech screen guard is extremely easy to install thanks to the smooth edges. It provides full-screen protection from scratch. What stands this tempered glass screen guard in good stead is the 9H hardness.

Being so robust, it can withstand even the sharp scratch by a knife. The crystal clarity ensures you have a great viewing experience. As it keeps grime and smudges away, you will continue to enjoy smooth-sailing touch experience.

USP: 9H Hardness
Check out on Amazon

4. iCarez

The one quality that makes iCarez screen protector a top choice is exceptional responsiveness. The premium tempered material retains its full-fledged functionality for long. Empowered by scratch-resistant coating, the screen guard doesn’t let scratch harm the screen of your device.

The high transparency ensures the retina display never loses its charm. Precise cutouts allow sensors and front camera to function without any disturbance. Lastly, it comes in a pack of two protectors with a single purchase.

USP: Touch-sensitive
Check out on Amazon

5. OMOTON

OMOTON screen guard boasts of high definition clarity. Endowed with industry-standard hardness, it has enough strength to keep scrape at bay. Since the protector is bubble-free, you will be able to install it without any hassle. What’s more, it doesn’t leave any residue behind when you remove it. Another important quality to take note of is that it is gifted with high sensitivity.

USP: Industry-standard hardness
Check out on Amazon

6. Halnziye

Halnziye screen guard comes with rounded edges that assist it is not just getting installed perfectly on the screen but also offer edge-to-edge protection. The industry-leading hardness has been further bolstered by the oleophobic coating that doesn’t allow fingerprints, oil or grime to damage its quality.

The premium tempered glass offers stunning clarity. Being quite smooth, your fingers have a nice feel when touching its surface. Moreover, the protector is solid enough to retain its impressive functionality for long.

USP: Round edges
Check out on Amazon

7. Ztotop

Ztotop screen protector has packed in with all the required qualities to be rated as a trusted shield for the touchscreen of your iPad. The slightly curved edges make it ultra-convenient to install the guard. Since there is no bubble at all; you won’t face any difficulty while putting it on the screen.

Since it doesn’t leave any residue behind when removed, you will be able to uninstall it without any pain at all. The Hydrophobic Oleophobic coating keeps both clarity and responsiveness intact by driving away dust, sweat, and fingerprints. It comes with two protectors inside the box.

USP: Anti-fingerprint
Check out on Amazon

8. amFilm

With 0.33mm thickness and robust hardness, amFilm has been primed to be an immaculate defender of your iPad Pro’s touchscreen. It has precise cutouts for front camera and sensors. The protector has curved edges which empower it to offer the complete safeguard to the screen. As for transparency and responsiveness, it’s right up there with the best. The screen guard doesn’t allow dust, grime or oil to build up.

USP: Anti-scratch
Check out on Amazon

9. ESR

ESR screen protector is made to be anti-scratch. Hence, the screen guard can help the touchscreen of your device to come out unscathed even from a brutal fall—face down. With 0.33 thickness, it has the strength to ward off scratch when it really matters the most.

Another thing worth mentioning is that this protector offers maximum clarity of 99% which is quite decent. Moreover, you will have a natural touch feel when interacting with the screen of your device.

USP: Shatter resistance
Check out on Amazon

10. iLLumiShield

Powered by a tempered ballistic glass screen, iLLumiShield is exactly what you need to keep the delicate touchscreen shielded from brutal scratch. The protector has the 9H hardness that can even knock down the scratch of a dagger.

Both in terms of offering natural touch feel and transparency, it stands up to the mark. And since there is no bubble at all, you will be able to put it on the screen with a breeze. Needless to say, it’s good enough to prevent grime or sweat from destroying your smooth experience.

USP: Natural touch feel
Check out on Amazon

That’s all!

Pick up the Right Shield

Which one of these screen guards has made it to your iPad Pro? Let me know its name and the quality that you have liked in it.

And yes, if I missed to include any quality screen guard, do inform me about that. One important thing, I will keep on updating this elite list so that you will easily find the most robust shield for your tablet.

Ditto, you would want to have a go at these lists as well:

  • Best 10.5-inch iPad Pro Keyboard Cases

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.
